controlsMoving.title: CONTROLS: MOVIN' AROUND
controlsMoving.description:
[ARROWS] OR [WASD] MOVE. [Z] OR [ENTER] CONFIRMS AN' TALKS. [X] OR [ESC] CANCELS. HOLD [Shift] TA RUN.

RUNNIN' SPENDS [AP | combatAP], DA SAME METER YA BATTLE SKILLS USE. STAND STILL OR WALK TA GET IT BACK.

[Z] ACTS ON DA TILE YOU FACE. ON A COMPANION IT OPENS A SHORT MENU: A QUICK CHAT, DEY [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] SHEET, OR DA RESERVES.

[Tab] MAKES DA NEXT MEMBER DA LEADER, [Shift] AN' [Tab] DA PREVIOUS ONE!

controlsMenus.title: CONTROLS: MENU HOTKEYS
controlsMenus.description:
[ESC] OR [RIGHT CLICK] OPENS DA MENU. HOLD [Tab] FOR DA QUICK MENU. ON DA MAP EACH SCREEN ALSO HAB A LETTER KEY:

- [I] BACKPACK, [C] STATUS, [O] EQUIPMENT, [U] SKILLS, [J] QUESTS
- [M] WORLD MAP, [B] BUILD, [V] VEHICLES, [R] WAIT AN' REST, [K] COOKIN'
- [H] DIS BOOK, [N] TRAININ', [P] HYPERDECK, [L] POLITICS

INSIDE DA MENU, [1] OPENS DA [THINKER | craftThinker]. ON DA MAP, [1] TA [9] USE DA QUICK BAR.

[F9] QUICKSAVE, [F10] QUICKLOAD, [F11] FULLSCREEN, [F3] SCREENSHOT. IF YOU IZ EVER STUCK, HOLD [CTRL] TA WALK THROUGH WALLS WHILE [CTRL NOCLIP | optionsMenu] IZ ON!

controlsMouse.title: CONTROLS: MOUSE
controlsMouse.description:
DA MOUSE DOES NO MOVE YA CHARACTER.

- [DRAG] PANS DA CAMERA. IT SNAPS BACK WHEN YOU WALK
- [WHEEL] OR [+] AN' [-] ZOOM DA WORLD MAP
- [HOVER] OVER SOMETINK TA SEE ITS NAME
- [RIGHT CLICK] OPENS DA MENU

IN BATTLE: [LEFT CLICK] AN BAD 'UN TA USE DA SELECTED COMMAND ON IT, [WHEEL] SCROLLS DA COMMANDS, [1] TA [9] CAST DA SKILLS ON DA QUICK BAR!

controlsGamepad.title: CONTROLS: CONTROLLER
controlsGamepad.description:
A CONTROLLER WORKS ON DA MAP, IN MENUS AN' IN BATTLE.

- [LEFT STICK] OR [D-PAD] MOVES, [RIGHT STICK] PANS DA CAMERA
- [A] CONFIRMS, [B] CANCELS, [X] RUNS, [Y] OPENS DA MENU. HOLD [Y] FOR DA QUICK MENU
- [L1] / [R1] STEP DA QUICK BAR ON DA MAP AN' CHANGE TAB IN MENUS
- [L2] / [R2] CHANGE CHARACTER IN MENUS. ON DA MAP [R2] CHANGES DA LEADER AN' A TAP OF [L2] FOLDS DA MAP NOTES
- HOLD [L2] AN' PUSH DA [RIGHT STICK] TA ZOOM DA WORLD MAP
- [L3] VEHICLES, [R3] BUILD, [START] WAIT AN' REST

[SEARCH FIELDS | controlsSearch] IZ HIDDEN ON A CONTROLLER!

controlsRemap.title: CONTROLS: REMAPPIN'
controlsRemap.description:
KEYS AN' BUTTONS NO CAN BE REBOUND. KEYBOARD AN' CONTROLLER BOTH WORK AT ALL TIMES.

DA FULL LISTS IZ ON [CONTROLS: MENU HOTKEYS | controlsMenus] AN' [CONTROLS: CONTROLLER | controlsGamepad]!

controlsScreen.title: WHAT IZ ON DA SCREEN
controlsScreen.description:
DA [PARTY HUD] SITS TOP LEFT: EACH MEMBER'S NAME, LEVEL, [HP], [AP | combatAP] AN' [MP]. IN BATTLE DA ONE ACTIN' IZ LIT.

LIL' [CHIPS] BESIDE EACH CARD WARN YOU OF TROUBLE: A NEED RUNNIN' LOW, A [CRAVIN' | needsAddiction], AN [ILLNESS | healthDiseases], A STATE. DEY CHANGE COLOUR AS TINKZ GET WORSE.

IN A VEHICLE, DA VEHICLE GETS ITS OWN ROW ABOVE DA CREW, WIT ITS CONDITION AN' [FUEL | vehicleFuel].

DA [QUICK BAR] SITS BOTTOM CENTRE: ITEMS ON DA MAP, SKILLS IN BATTLE!

controlsSearch.title: SEARCHIN' INSIDE MENUS
controlsSearch.description:
EVERY LONG LIST HAB A SEARCH STRIP, DIS BOOK INCLUDED. CLICK DA MAGNIFIER AT DA TOP OF DA PAGE, OR PRESS [F], TA OPEN IT.

- WHILE YOU TYPE, MENU HOTKEYS STAY QUIET
- [Escape] EMPTIES DA FIELD, [Escape] AGAIN LEAVES IT
- ON A CONTROLLER DA MAGNIFIER IZ HIDDEN

DA [MAIN MENU SEARCH] LOOKS ACROSS SEVERAL SCREENS AT ONCE: YA ITEMS, YA COMPANIONS' GEAR, SKILLS, RECIPES, CREATURES!

savingGame.title: STASHIN', AUTOSAVE AN' QUICKSAVES
savingGame.description:
DA GAME [AUTOSAVES] WHEN YOU CHANGE MAP. HOW OFTEN IZ UP TA YOU IN [FIDDLY BITS | optionsMenu].

[F9] QUICKSAVES AN' [F10] LOADS DA LATEST QUICKSAVE, ON DA MAP WHENEVER NUTTIN' ELSE IZ HAPPENIN'. DA [REST MENU | needsRestWorth] HAB A STASH ENTRY TOO.

DA STASH SCREEN ALSO LISTS DA OTHER PARTIES OF YA WORLD. YOU CAN LOAD DEM, BUT NEVER STASH OVER DEM.

YOU NO CAN STASH ON DA FLOORS OF [DA DUNGEON | worldDungeon]. DA [SANDBOX | setupSandbox] KEEPS ITS OWN STASH APART FROM EVERYTINK ELSE.

WARNIN': UNDER [PERMADEATH | partyDeath], DEATH DELETES DAT PARTY'S STASHES FOR GOOD. ITS [DIARY | societyDiary] SURVIVES!

worldsFolders.title: WORLDS AN' SAVEGAMES
worldsFolders.description:
A [WORLD] IZ A PLACE DAT OUTLIVES ANY ONE ADVENTURE. A DEFAULT WORLD CALLED [ESOTERIC] IZ ALWAYS DERE. YOU CAN MAKE MORE ON DA [WORLDS] SCREEN, SEE [CREATIN' A WORLD | setupWorldCreation].

EACH WORLD ARRIVES ALREADY LIVED IN, WIT [A CENTURY OF HISTORY | societyHistory], PEOPLE, HOMES, JOBS AN' POLITICS OF ITS OWN.

EVERY PARTY YOU PLAY IN A WORLD SHARES IT, AN' INHERITS WHAT DA OTHERS LEFT BEHIND. AN EMPTIED CHEST STAYS EMPTY, BUILT FURNITURE STAYS BUILT, AN' TIME ONLY MOVES [FORWARD].

YA OTHER PARTIES LIVE ON AS [CHARACTERS ON THE MAP], GOING 'BOUT DEY DAY. YOU CAN STOP AN' TALK WIT DEM.

WARNIN': DELETIN' A WORLD DELETES ALL OF ITS SAVEGAMES. ESOTERIC CAN ONLY BE RESET, WHICH WIPES ITS HISTORY AN' STASHES!

optionsMenu.title: FIDDLY BITS
optionsMenu.description:
FIDDLY BITS IZ SPLIT INTO TABS:

- [GAMEPLAY]: LANGUAGE, [DIFFICULTY | combatModes], [MAP BATTLES | combatMapBattle], [FOG OF WAR | worldFog], DIALOGUE, AUTOSAVE
- [VIDEO]: THEME, FULLSCREEN, SCALIN', TEXT SIZE
- [AUDIO]: VOLUMES, BATTLE MUSIC, VOICES
- [SHADER]: DA RETRO LOOK OF DA 3D SCENES
- [EXPERIMENTAL]: DA [AUTO EXPLORER | partyAutoIdle], ASCII MODE, CTRL NOCLIP AN' OTHER CURIOSITIES

[CTRL NOCLIP] IZ ON BY DEFAULT: HOLD [CTRL] TA WALK STRAIGHT THROUGH WALLS AN' ENCOUNTERS. USE IT TA GET FREE IF YOU IZ EVER STUCK!

modsUpdates.title: MODS AN' UPDATES
modsUpdates.description:
DA DESKTOP GAME READS A [MODS] FOLDER NEXT TA IT. DROP A MOD IN AN' IT CAN CHANGE OR ADD ALMOST ANYTINK.

IN DA [MOD MANAGER], [ENTER] TURNS A MOD ON OR OFF AN' [PAGE UP] / [PAGE DOWN] CHANGE DA LOAD ORDER. DA MOD AT DA [BOTTOM] WINS. CHANGES APPLY DA NEXT TIME YOU START.

DA [UPDATES] ENTRY ON DA TITLE SCREEN FETCHES DA NEWEST BUILD AN' ASKS YOU TA REOPEN DA GAME. YOU CAN PICK A STABLE OR AN UNSTABLE CHANNEL, AN' GO BACK TA AN EARLIER BUILD IF YOU NEED TA!

partyBasics.title: DA PARTY
partyBasics.description:
DA PARTY HOLDS [3 MEMBERS]. DA FIRST IZ DA [LEADER], DA ONE YOU STEER. [Tab] PASSES DA LEAD ON.

A [4TH COMPANION | partyPets] CAN WALK ALONG TOO, OUTSIDE DA FIGHTIN'.

EACH MEMBER HAB DEY OWN [NEEDS | needsOverview], OPINIONS AN' [SPECIALIZATIONS | progressSpecializations], AN' DEY OWN FEELINGS 'BOUT DA OTHER TWO. LEFT TA THEMSELVES DEY WANDER NEAR DA LEADER, AN' SLIP OFF TA EAT, WASH OR REST WHEN DEY NEED TA, PAID FROM DA PARTY PURSE.

RUN FOR A MOMENT TA CALL EVERYONE BACK IN!

partyCreation.title: MAKIN' YA CHARACTERS
partyCreation.description:
YOU MAKE YA CHARACTERS ONE AT A TIME, UP TA [3], IN ONE OF THREE WAYS:

- [SIMPLE]: LOOK, CLASS, [TRAITS | partyTraits], GEAR
- [DOSSIERS]: READY MADE CHARACTERS, SOME WIT A VEHICLE OR A HOMETOWN OF DEY OWN. SOME CAN BE USED ONLY ONCE
- [DETAILED]: DA WHOLE SHEET, DOWN TA BELIEFS AN' BACKSTORY

YA [CLASS | partyClasses] DECIDES YA STARTIN' KIT!

partyClasses.title: CLASSES
partyClasses.description:
A CLASS SHAPES WHO YOU START AS: YA STATS, YA KIT, A [FAVOURED ELEMENT | elementsOverview] AN' DA SCHOOLS OF MAGIC AN' SKILL DAT COME NATURALLY TA YOU.

SKILLS FROM YA OWN SCHOOLS IZ CHEAPER IN [KNOWLEDGE POINTS | progressKnowledge]. OTHER SCHOOLS OPEN UP ONCE YOU HAB A FOOTHOLD IN DEM, AT A STEEPER PRICE.

ANY CLASS CAN USE ANY WEAPON. HOW WELL IZ A [TRAINABLE PROFICIENCY | gearProficiency].

[CREATURE CLASSES | partyCreatures], SUCH AS FERAL, GHOST OR DRONE, IZ SOMETINK ELSE: IN DA WORLD DEY IZ ANIMALS, NO PEOPLE!

partyTraits.title: TRAITS
partyTraits.description:
TRAITS IZ CHOSEN AT CREATION WIT A LIL' BUDGET OF POINTS. STRENGTHS COST POINTS, DRAWBACKS GIVE SOME BACK.

DEY SHAPE YA STATS, HAND YOU SKILLS AN' GEAR, AN' COLOUR HOW PEOPLE AN' DA WORLD REACT TA YOU.

MOST TRAITS IZ YA FOR LIFE. ONLY [GENETIC] ONES CAN CHANGE LATER, THROUGH [GENE SPLICIN' | healthSurgery], FOR [100 EUROS] PER POINT!

partyAttributes.title: ATTRIBUTES
partyAttributes.description:
SIX ATTRIBUTES DESCRIBE A BODY AN' A MIND:

- [STR]: PHYSICAL ATTACK, [CARRYIN' CAPACITY | gearWeight]
- [CON]: PHYSICAL DEFENSE, CARRYIN' CAPACITY
- [INT]: MAGIC ATTACK
- [WIS]: MAGIC DEFENSE
- [DEX]: WHO ACTS FIRST, DODGIN'
- [PSI]: LUCK. CRITICAL HITS, [RARE FINDS | gearRarity] AN' FORTUNE IN GENERAL

partyCreatures.title: PLAYIN' A CREATURE
partyCreatures.description:
A PARTY MEMBER CAN BE A [CREATURE], BUILT FROM ONE SPECIES OR TWO CROSSED TOGETHER.

DA SPECIES GIVES DA BODY: ITS LIMBS, ITS REACH, ITS HANDS OR LACK OF DEM, AN' ITS [WEAK POINTS | combatBodyParts]. ANATOMY DECIDES HOW MANY [WEAPONS IT CAN HOLD | gearSlots] AN' EVEN WHAT A [PREGNANCY | partyReproduction] BRINGS.

OUT IN DA WORLD, A CREATURE ON A [CREATURE CLASS | partyClasses] IZ AN ANIMAL. YA KEEP DEY MONEY AN' BELONGINGS ALL DA SAME. PICK A [CIVILISED CLASS] INSTEAD AN' YOU IZ A PERSON SHAPED LIKE AN ANIMAL!

partyPortraits.title: PORTRAITS AN' 3D MODELS
partyPortraits.description:
EACH CHARACTER IZ SHOWN AS A HAND DRAWN [BUST] OR A [3D MODEL]. PICK ONE ON DA BIO TAB AN' SWITCH WHENEVER YOU LIKE.

DA MODEL IZ BUILT FROM PARTS OF ANY CREATURE, WIT SLIDERS TA SHAPE IT. PEOPLE DEFAULT TA A BUST, CREATURES TA A MODEL.

[RECRUITED | partyRecruiting] MONSTERS AN' [SUMMONS | combatSummons] WEAR DEY SPECIES' BODY. DA STATUS SCREEN, DIALOGUE AN' DA [EMPATHIZE PANEL | peopleEmpathize] ALL FOLLOW YA CHOICE!

partyRecruiting.title: RECRUITIN' PEOPLE
partyRecruiting.description:
DERE IZ THREE WAYS TA WIN SOMEONE OVER: [TALK A MONSTER ROUND | combatTalk], ASK A TOWNSPERSON THROUGH [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize], OR ADOPT AN' TRAIN A CREATURE.

DA BETTER SOMEONE THINKS OF YOU, DA LIKELIER DEY SAY YES, SO BUILD DEY [OPINION | peopleOpinion] FIRST. PEOPLE FAR STRONGER DEN YOU WILL NO FOLLOW.

DA PANEL OFFERS [JOIN PARTY], OR [JOIN AS FOLLOWER]: DEY WALK BEHIND YOU AS YA [4TH COMPANION | partyPets] INSTEAD.

DA PARTY HOLDS THREE, SO ANYONE EXTRA WAITS IN DA [RESERVES]. A DISMISSED MEMBER GOES HOME.

SHOPKEEPERS CAN BE RECRUITED TOO. SOME PEOPLE NEVER JOIN!

partyPets.title: PETS, FOLLOWERS AN' CHILDREN
partyPets.description:
A [4TH COMPANION] CAN FOLLOW DA PARTY WITOUT FIGHTIN' OR COMIN' TA HARM. DA EXCEPTION IZ A [FAMILIAR | partyFamiliar], WHICH FIGHTS BESIDE YOU.

A [FOLLOWER] IZ A TALKIN' MONSTER OR A PERSON WHO CHOSE TA COME ALONG. A [PET] IZ A CREATURE DAT DOES NO TALK, A [CHILD] COMES FROM A [PREGNANCY | partyReproduction]. PICK WHO WALKS WIT YOU ON DA [FOLLOWERS] PAGE.

WARNIN': ABANDONIN' A PET OR, FAR WORSE, A CHILD IZ A [CRIME | lawCrime]. A FOLLOWER CAN BE SENT AWAY FREELY.

GIVEN TIME ON DA ROAD, PETS AN' FOLLOWERS CAN BE [TRAINED] INTO FULL PARTY MEMBERS. [ANIMAL TRAININ' | progressSpecializations] SPEEDS IT UP.

MOST COMPANIONS CAN BE MARKED [RIDABLE] AN' [RIDDEN | partyRiding], AN' DA [SUMMON BEAST | combatSummons] RITE CALLS YA PET INTO A FIGHT!

partyReproduction.title: REPRODUCTION AN' PREGNANCY
partyReproduction.description:
EACH SPECIES REPRODUCES ITS OWN WAY: LIVE BIRTH, EGGS, SEEDS OR SPLITTIN' IN TWO.

TRACK A PREGNANCY IN [BIOLOGICS | bodyBiologics]. EXPECT SYMPTOMS.

NEWBORNS AN' HATCHLINGS APPEAR IN [FOLLOWERS | partyPets] AS CHILDREN WHO TAKE AFTER DEY PARENT!

partyDeath.title: DEATH, GRAVESTONES AN' PERMADEATH
partyDeath.description:
A KILLIN' BLOW ON A HEALTHY MEMBER USUALLY LEAVES DEM HANGIN' ON. YOU CAN ALWAYS FLEE, EXCEPT FROM A BOSS.

A FALLEN MEMBER NORMALLY JUST LOSES CONSCIOUSNESS AN' COMES ROUND LATER. IF DA WHOLE PARTY GOES DOWN, YOU WAKE UP HEALED: AT YA [LAST STASH | savingGame] ON A HAND MADE MAP, OR OUT IN DA OPEN WORLD WHERE YOU LAST [SLEPT IN CAMP | needsCamp].

WARNIN': UNDER [PERMADEATH | combatModes] OR [BLOOD AND OIL], ALLIES NO REVIVED BEFORE DA BATTLE ENDS IZ GONE FOR GOOD, AN' DA OTHERS GRIEVE DEM. A FULL WIPE LEAVES A [GRAVESTONE] AN' DELETES DA PARTY'S STASHES. DA WORLD GOES ON.

HEALIN' DOES NO REGROW [SEVERED LIMBS | bodyParts]!

partyBanterPage.title: WHAT YA COMPANIONS SAY
partyBanterPage.description:
YA COMPANIONS TALK AMONG THEMSELVES 'BOUT WHATEVER IZ GOING ON: SOMETINK YOU JUST BOUGHT, A WOUND, DA WEATHER, DA MONEY, DA LEADER'S LATEST PLAN, SOMETINK FROM DA [DIARY | societyDiary].

EACH ONE'S [PERSONALITY] COLOURS WHAT DEY SAY, AN' DEY KEEP CHATTIN' ON DA ROAD, IN DA CAR AN' ON DA TRAIN!

partyAutoIdle.title: DA AUTO EXPLORER
partyAutoIdle.description:
AN [EXPERIMENTAL | optionsMenu] OPTION LETS DA GAME PLAY FOR YOU WHILE YOU STAND STILL. TOUCH ANYTINK AN' CONTROL COMES STRAIGHT BACK. AN AUTO BADGE SHOWS WHILE IT PLAYS.

IT WANDERS FROM MAP TA MAP, EATS, HEALS, SHOPS, LEARNS SKILLS, [WORKS DA LAND | worldTerrain] AN' FIGHTS, KEEPIN' CLEAR OF FIGHTS IT NO CAN WIN AN' OF DA POLICE WHEN YOU IZ [WANTED | lawCrime].

DA LEADER'S [MORALITY] SHOWS IN HOW IT PLAYS. A KIND LEADER CHATS WIT PEOPLE. A RUTHLESS ONE MAY [STEAL | econStealing] WHAT DA PARTY NEEDS, AN' TAKE DA CONSEQUENCES!

progressLevels.title: LEVELS AN' EXPERIENCE
progressLevels.description:
EXPERIENCE COMES MOSTLY FROM [WINNING FIGHTS], AN' ALSO FROM [ADVENTURES | worldAdventures] AN' [RESEARCH | worldTechTree]. EACH LEVEL MAKES YOU A LIL' STRONGER ALL ROUND.

LEVELS IZ ONLY PART OF YA POWER. SKILLS, [SPECIALIZATIONS | progressSpecializations], GEAR AN' YA BODY MATTER MORE!

progressKnowledge.title: KNOWLEDGE POINTS
progressKnowledge.description:
[KNOWLEDGE POINTS], OR KP, IZ WHAT YOU SPEND TA LEARN AN' CREATE SKILLS. DEY BELONG TA DA WHOLE PARTY, AN' DA TOTAL IZ SHOWN IN DA [TRAININ' | progressTraining] MENU. EVERY NEW MEMBER ADDS KP DA FIRST TIME DEY JOIN.

YOU EARN KP BY BEING CURIOUS:

- WINNIN' FIGHTS, ESPECIALLY AGAINST STRONGER FOES
- [QUESTS | econQuests], [ADVENTURES | worldAdventures] AN' [ANOMALIES | galaxyAnomalies]
- [DREAMS | worldDreams] AN' [FORAGIN' | needsForage]
- READIN' A [BOOK | pastimesReading] OR STUDYIN' A STATUE OR FOSSIL FOR DA FIRST TIME
- [RAMAN SCANS | gamesRaman] AN' NEW PAGES IN DA [BROWSER | hypernetBrowser]
- [HEXORCIZIN' | progressHexorcize] MAGICAL GEAR

YOU SPEND IT ON:

- SKILLS ON DA [SCHOOL TREES | progressAtlas]
- [FUSIN' SPELLS | progressFusion], [WRITIN' YA OWN | progressWorkbench], [ENCHANTIN' | progressEnchanting] AN' [WRITIN' BOOKS | progressWritingBooks]
- [INTROSPECT] IN DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL, TA CHANGE WHO YOU IZ

YA OWN SCHOOLS COST LESS. LEARNIN' FROM A PERSON IN EMPATHIZE COSTS EUROS INSTEAD, AN' A MATE TEACHES FOR FREE!

progressAtlas.title: DA SKILL ATLAS
progressAtlas.description:
EACH SCHOOL IZ A HAND DRAWN [TREE]. DA ROOTS SIT AT DA TOP AN' EVERY ROW BELOW GROWS STRONGER.

TA BUY A SKILL YOU MUST KNOW DA ONES IT GROWS FROM. IN YA OWN SCHOOLS DA ROOTS IZ ALWAYS OPEN. DA DEEPEST [ESOTERIC] AN' [FORBIDDEN] BRANCHES ALSO WAIT UNTIL YOU IZ EXPERIENCED ENOUGH. A [CULTIST | partyClasses] LEARNS NUTTIN' HERE, ONLY FROM [BOOKS | progressGrimoires].

USE DA ARROWS BY DA SCHOOL'S NAME TA CHANGE TREE. [WHEEL] OR [+] AN' [-] ZOOM, [DRAG] PANS!

progressTraining.title: TRAININ' AN' PROGRESSION
progressTraining.description:
SKILLS IZ BOUGHT WIT [KP | progressKnowledge] IN DA [TRAINING] MENU, INSTANTLY.

DA MORE YOU USE A SKILL, DA BETTER YOU GET AT ITS SCHOOL, THROUGH [SPECIALIZATIONS | progressSpecializations]. PRACTICE MAKES IT HIT HARDER AN' HEAL MORE!

progressSpecializations.title: SPECIALIZATIONS
progressSpecializations.description:
SPECIALIZATIONS IZ EVERYTINK YOU CAN GET GOOD AT, FROM WRESTLIN' TA ACCOUNTIN' TA BEEKEEPIN'. EACH CLIMBS FROM UNTRAINED TA MASTER.

YOU LEARN BY DOING. COOKIN' MAKES YOU A BETTER COOK, HAGGLIN' A SHARPER TRADER, CASTIN' A STRONGER CASTER. WHOEVER DOES DA WORK LEARNS DA MOST, AN' DA REST OF DA PARTY PICKS UP A LIL'. [MINIGAMES | gamesOverview] TEACH TOO.

YA [CLASS | partyClasses] AN' [TRAITS | partyTraits] CAN GIVE YOU A HEAD START. POINTS LEFT OVER AT [CHARACTER CREATION | partyCreation] IZ [BANKED]: SPEND DEM IN DA SPECIALIZATIONS MENU TA JUMP A SPECIALIZATION UP A TIER.

DEY MATTER EVERYWHERE: FORGIN', [LOCKPICKIN' | gamesLockpick], [WRESTLIN' HOLDS | combatWrestle], SHOP PRICES, QUEST PAY, EVEN WHETHER YOU CAN READ A RECIPE!

progressPassives.title: CLASS PASSIVES
progressPassives.description:
EVERY [CLASS | partyClasses] HAB ONE [SIGNATURE PASSIVE] DAT IZ ALWAYS ACTIVE, IN AN' OUT OF BATTLE. SOME [TRAITS | partyTraits] ADD DEY OWN. ONLY DA THREE PARTY MEMBERS COUNT.

FIND DEM ON DA STATUS SHEET UNDER [CLASS ABILITIES]!

progressLoadout.title: DA NINE SKILL SLOTS
progressLoadout.description:
EACH CHARACTER CARRIES [9 SKILLS] INTO A FIGHT, FILLIN' DA [BATTLE QUICK BAR]. BASIC MOVES AN' SKILLS LENT BY GEAR COME FREE.

SOME SKILLS ASK FOR A MINIMUM IN A [STAT | partyAttributes], AN' ONLY YA OWN BODY AN' TRAININ' COUNT, NO YA GEAR. IF YOU FALL SHORT YOU NO CAN CARRY DA SKILL.

A SKILL LENT BY GEAR CAN BE USED ANYWAY, BUT IT MAY [FUMBLE], WASTIN' ITS [MP | combatAP]. DA SKILL CARD WARNS YOU HOW RISKY IT IZ.

CHANGE YA LOADOUT BETWEEN FIGHTS AS OFTEN AS YOU LIKE!

progressFusion.title: FUSIN' SPELLS
progressFusion.description:
[FUSE SPELLS], ON DA RIGHT PAGE OF [TRAININ' | progressTraining], FUSES TWO ABILITIES A MEMBER KNOWS INTO A NEW ONE.

1. PICK DA MEMBER IN DA COMPANION TABS.
2. PUT A SPELL IN DA [DOMINANT] SLOT. IT SETS DA SHAPE OF DA RESULT.
3. PUT A SPELL OR SKILL IN DA [RECESSIVE] SLOT.
4. PICK AN ANIMATION, OR KEEP DA OLD ONE.
5. PRESS CREATE AN' ROLL.

DA NEW ABILITY HAB DA EFFECTS OF BOTH, COSTS BOTH, AN' CAN BE RENAMED. IT COSTS [KP | progressKnowledge], AN' YA [INT | partyAttributes] HELPS DA [ROLL | partyDiceChecks]. A PERFECT ROLL CREATES SOMETINK EXCEPTIONAL.

WARNIN': ON A FAILURE DA KP IZ LOST AN' BOTH PARTS IZ FORGOTTEN. YOU CAN BUY DEM AGAIN ON DA [TREE | progressAtlas].

YOU NO CAN FUSE AN ALREADY FUSED OR [CRAFTED | progressWorkbench] ABILITY. LATER, [SPLIT] GIVES YOU DA TWO PARTS BACK, AN' [DISSOLVE] TRADES DA ABILITY FOR SOME OF ITS KP!

progressGrimoires.title: GRIMOIRES AN' SKILL BOOKS
progressGrimoires.description:
A [GRIMOIRE] OPENS TA A HANDFUL OF WORKINGS, AN' ONE READER MAY TAKE ONE. DA OFFERS IZ FIXED ONCE DA BOOK IZ OPENED: CLOSIN' IT OR CHANGIN' READER WILL NO CHANGE DEM.

A READER CAN ONLY TAKE A WORKIN' DEY IZ READY FOR, WIT ENOUGH MP AN' DA RIGHT [STATS | progressLoadout]. FORBIDDEN PAGES ASK FOR MORE.

LUCK, YA PARTY'S [PSI | partyAttributes], MAKES DARKER PAGES MORE LIKELY. BEYOND DA SCHOOL GRIMOIRES AN' SKILL BOOKS LIES DA [FORBIDDEN GRIMOIRE], WHICH OFFERS NUTTIN' ELSE!

progressExpressionSeeds.title: EXPRESSION SEEDS
progressExpressionSeeds.description:
AN [EXPRESSION SEED] IZ USED ON ONE CHARACTER FROM DA BACKPACK AN' UNLOCKS DEY EXPRESSION. IT IZ REFUSED ON A CHARACTER WHO ALREADY HAB IT.

DA EXPRESSIONS BUTTON ON DA RIGHT PAGE OF DA SKILLS BENCHES LISTS EVERYONE IN DA PARTY WIT EXPRESSION UNLOCKED, AN' STAYS GREYED OUT WHILE NOBODY HAB IT.

A POWER CAN BE BOUND BY LIMITATIONS: NEVER ON A CHOSEN DAY, ONLY AGAINST ONE KIND OF CREATURE, ONLY BY NIGHT, ONLY AT A PRICE IN BLOOD OR GOLD. DA MORE A POWER IZ BOUND, DA LESS IT COSTS, AN' DA FURTHER IT CAN REACH BEYOND DA CHARACTER'S STATS!

gearSlots.title: EQUIPMENT: HANDS AN' SLOTS
gearSlots.description:
WHAT YOU CAN HOLD DEPENDS ON YA [BODY | bodyParts]. A HAND TAKES A WEAPON OR A SHIELD, A [TWO HANDED] WEAPON NEEDS BOTH, AN' A CREATURE WIT NO HANDS CAN STILL BITE DOWN ON A BLADE.

WIT A WEAPON IN EACH HAND, ATTACK STRIKES WIT BOTH: DA OFF HAND FOLLOWS UP WIT A LIGHTER BLOW OF ITS OWN. WIELDIN' MORE DEN ONE WEAPON IZ CLUMSY UNLESS YA [CLASS | partyClasses] KNOWS DUAL WIELD.

WARNIN': IN [BLOOD AN' OIL | combatModes], LOSIN' A LIMB DROPS WHATEVER IT HELD!

gearProficiency.title: WEAPON PROFICIENCY
gearProficiency.description:
ANY CLASS CAN PICK UP ANY WEAPON, BUT SKILL WIT EACH KIND IZ A [SPECIALIZATION | progressSpecializations] OF ITS OWN. YA [CLASS | partyClasses] ALREADY KNOWS ITS TRADITIONAL WEAPONS. DA REST START CLUMSY.

AN UNTRAINED HAND GETS FAR LESS OUT OF A WEAPON, A MASTER GETS MORE. EVERY BATTLE YOU WIN WIT A WEAPON EQUIPPED TEACHES YOU A LIL'!

gearScaling.title: WHAT A WEAPON SCALES ON
gearScaling.description:
EACH WEAPON DRAWS ITS STRENGTH FROM ONE OR TWO STATS. MOST RELY ON [STR | partyAttributes], FIREARMS ON [DEX], DA HEAVIEST ON BOTH.

DA EQUIP SCREEN HIGHLIGHTS WHICH STATS A WEAPON USES!

gearArmor.title: ARMOUR AN' DERIVED STATS
gearArmor.description:
WHAT YOU WEAR SAYS SOMETINK 'BOUT YOU. YA OUTFIT GIVES YOU FOUR LOOKS: [ARCANE], [SUBSTANCE], [STEALTH] AN' [INTIMIDATION].

- ROBES AN' STAVES LOOK ARCANE
- DAGGERS, BOWS AN' LIGHT ARMOUR LOOK STEALTHY
- HEAVY ARMOUR, AXES AN' GUNS LOOK INTIMIDATIN'

PEOPLE NOTICE. YA LOOK SWAYS HOW DEY FEEL IN [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize], AN' HOW [THEFT | econStealing], BRIBES, ROMANCE AN' [RECRUITIN' | partyRecruiting] GO!

gearModifiers.title: MODIFIERS ON GEAR
gearModifiers.description:
A WEAPON OR PIECE OF ARMOUR CAN HAB A [MODIFIER] DAT CHANGES ITS STATS AN' PRICE.

A FEW YOU MAY MEET ON WEAPONS:
- [SHARP] CUTS DEEPER, [VENOMOUS] [POISONS | poison], [CHILLING] CAN [FREEZE | freeze]
- [VAMPIRIC] DRINKS LIFE BACK, [BERSERK] HITS TERRIBLY HARD BUT LEAVES YOU EXPOSED
- [DULL] AN' [BROKEN] IZ WORTH LESS

AN' ON ARMOUR:
- [REGENERATIVE] HEALS YOU, [RETALIATING] ADDS [COUNTERATTACKS | counterAttack]
- [BLESSED] SOFTENS BLOWS, [WORN] IZ CHEAPER AN' WEAKER

DEY OFTEN SHOW UP ON PEOPLE'S CUSTOM PIECES!

gearWeight.title: WEIGHT AN' ENCUMBRANCE
gearWeight.description:
ONLY WHAT SITS IN DA [BACKPACK | gearBackpack] WEIGHS ANYTINK. WHAT YOU WEAR IZ FREE, AN' FOOD IZ LIGHT.

DA WHOLE PARTY SHARES ONE LOAD, AN' STRONG, STURDY MEMBERS CARRY MORE OF IT ([STR | partyAttributes] AN' CON). DA WEIGHT READOUT TURNS ORANGE AS YOU NEAR DA LIMIT. GO OVER AN' YOU SLOW TA A CRAWL UNTIL YOU DROP SOMETINK.

IN A [VEHICLE | vehiclesOverview], WEIGHT DOES NO MATTER!

gearBackpack.title: DA BACKPACK
gearBackpack.description:
DA BACKPACK IZ SORTED INTO TABS, WIT DA [WEIGHT READOUT | gearWeight], A DETAIL CARD AN' A FAVOURITES BAR.

[9 FAVOURITE SLOTS] HOLD USABLE ITEMS AN' SHARE DA QUICK BAR WIT YA [BATTLE SKILLS | progressLoadout].

- ON DA MAP, [1] TA [9] USE DA ITEM IN DAT SLOT
- IN DA BACKPACK, DA SAME KEYS PUT DA ITEM YOU IZ LOOKIN' AT INTO A SLOT
- [DRAG] AN ITEM ONTO A SLOT, [RIGHT CLICK] TA CLEAR IT

gearArtifacts.title: ARTIFACTS
gearArtifacts.description: NO ARTIFACTS CAN BE FOUND FOR NOW. SOME PEOPLE OWN A [UNIQUE PIECE] MADE FOR DEM, AN' ITS DESCRIPTION LISTS EVERY PAST OWNER!

gearContainers.title: CONTAINERS AN' STORAGE
gearContainers.description:
CHESTS, CUPBOARDS, CRATES AN' SACKS HOLD AS MUCH AS YOU LIKE. EMPTYIN' ONE IN SOMEBODY'S HOME IZ [THEFT | lawCrime].

AN [EXTRADIMENSIONAL CONTAINER | craftContainers] AN' DA HOLDS OF YA [VEHICLES | vehiclesOverview] TRAVEL WIT YOU!

gearRarity.title: LOOT AN' RARITY
gearRarity.description:
[RANDOM LOOT | craftLoot] GROWS WIT DA WHOLE PARTY'S STRENGTH. DANGEROUS GROUND AN' DA [OMEGA TOWER | omegaTower] PAY BEST.

ITEMS WEAR DEY [RARITY COLOUR] IN DA BACKPACK AN' IN SHOPS, AN' EVERY ITEM HAB ITS OWN [LORE], FIXED FOR EACH WORLD!

needsOverview.title: DA SIX NEEDS
needsOverview.description:
EVERY PARTY MEMBER HAB SIX NEEDS: [HUNGER | needsHunger], [SLEEP | needsSleep], [HYGIENE | needsHygiene], [COMPANY | needsSocial], [FUN | needsLeisure] AN' [BLADDER | needsBladder]. DEY DRAIN AS TIME PASSES, AN' TIME PASSES AS YOU WALK. RUNNIN' MAKES DEM DRAIN FASTER.

COMPANY IZ DIFFERENT: TRAVELLIN' TOGETHER KEEPS IT UP, AN' ONLY A LONE TRAVELLER GROWS LONELY.

A CHIP APPEARS BESIDE A MEMBER'S CARD WHEN A NEED RUNS LOW. DO NO IGNORE IT: AN EMPTY STOMACH STARTS TA HURT, AN' A TIRED BODY RECOVERS POORLY.

SOME [AUGMENTS | healthAugments] CAN SLOW A NEED, OR SILENCE IT ALTOGETHER!

needsHunger.title: HUNGER AN' NUTRITION
needsHunger.description:
EVERYTINK YOU EAT HAB [CALORIES], FAT AN' PROTEIN. A MEAL IZ WORTH WHAT IT CONTAINS, NO WHAT IT COSTS.

YOU CAN EAT PAST FULL, BUT AN OVERSTUFFED STOMACH EMPTIES FASTER AN' GORGIN' TOO FAR BRINGS [NAUSEA | nausea].

BITTER COLD AN' HEAVY HEAT BOTH MAKE YOU HUNGRY SOONER.

LET HUNGER RUN DRY AN' DA WHOLE PARTY STARTS LOSIN' HEALTH WIT EVERY STEP UNTIL SOMEBODY EATS!

needsSleep.title: SLEEP, REST AN' TIME AWAKE
needsSleep.description:
TWO TINKZ WEAR ON YOU: HOW TIRED YOU IZ, AN' HOW LONG YOU HAB GONE WITOUT REAL SLEEP.

DA [SLEEP METER] DIPS AS YOU TRAVEL. COFFEE OR A SEAT TOPS IT UP, AN' A TIRED PARTY RECOVERS LESS MP ON DA ROAD.

[TIME AWAKE] ONLY RESETS IN A REAL BED OR A CRYOGENIC POD. GO DAYS WITOUT IT AN' [DREAMS | worldDreams] TURN HOSTILE AN' DA PARTY'S MIND STARTS TA FRAY.

BEDS, CAMPFIRES, TENTS AN' WORLD MAP [CAMPS | needsCamp] OPEN DA [REST MENU | needsRestWorth]. [WAIT], FROM DA MENU OR DA [R] KEY, PASSES TIME AN' LETS YOU SLEEP ROUGH WHERE YOU STAND, THOUGH IT IZ A POOR NIGHT UNLESS YOU CARRY BEDDIN'.

[CRYOGENIC SLEEP] LETS YOU SKIP AHEAD TA A DAY YOU CHOOSE, FOR [30 EUROS] A DAY. DA WORLD MOVES ON WITOUT YOU, AN' YOU WAKE EXACTLY AS YOU WENT IN, WOUNDS AN' ALL!

needsHygiene.title: HYGIENE
needsHygiene.description:
HYGIENE FADES SLOWLY. WASH AT A WASHROOM, SHOWER, SINK OR FOUNTAIN. COMPANIONS LEFT TA WANDER WILL FIND ONE THEMSELVES.

PEOPLE NOTICE. A GRUBBY TRAVELLER MAKES A WORSE IMPRESSION, AN' A GRUBBY STRANGER MAKES A WORSE ONE ON YOU.

HOW MUCH IT MATTERS DEPENDS ON [TRAITS | partyTraits]. A FERAL OR ASCETIC SOUL HARDLY CARES, WHILE DA PROUD, DA NOBLE AN' DA GERMAPHOBE CARE A GREAT DEAL.

WHEN [COURTING], A BATH CAN MAKE ALL DA DIFFERENCE!

needsSocial.title: COMPANY
needsSocial.description:
COMPANY FILLS WHILE YOU TRAVEL WIT SOMEONE, AN' A [PET | partyPets] HELPS TOO. ONLY A LONE TRAVELLER FEELS IT DRAIN.

[TALKIN' | peopleEmpathize] ALSO HELPS, TA TOWNSPEOPLE OR AMONG YA OWN. A COMPANION LEFT LOOSE AN' SHORT OF COMPANY WILL STRIKE UP A CONVERSATION BY THEMSELVES.

WINNIN' SOMEONE'S [REGARD | peopleOpinion] WARMS DA WHOLE PARTY. LOSIN' IT STINGS A LIL'!

needsLeisure.title: FUN
needsLeisure.description:
FUN SLOWLY DRAINS AS YOU WALK. REFILL IT BY [PLAYIN' | gamesOverview]: ARCADE CABINETS, POOL, BOWLIN', CARDS, BOOKS, TV, DA [ARENA | combatArena].

A GAME WON LIFTS SPIRITS A LOT, A GAME LOST BRINGS DEM DOWN. GAMES OF CHANCE CAN ALSO FEED A [GAMBLIN' CRAVIN' | needsAddiction].

A WON FIGHT CHEERS DA PARTY, ESPECIALLY DOZE WHO LOVE A SCRAP. A PACIFIST TAKES NO JOY IN IT.

LOSIN' A COMPANION FOR GOOD HURTS, MORE SO FOR DOZE WHO WAZ CLOSE. A JOKE OR A STORY DAT LANDS IN CONVERSATION BRIGHTENS EVERYONE, AN' AN ENTERTAINER IN DA PARTY KEEPS SPIRITS UP!

needsAddiction.title: CRAVINGS AN' WITHDRAWAL
needsAddiction.description:
SOME [TRAITS] IZ DEPENDENCIES: ALCOHOL, CAFFEINE, NICOTINE, NARCOTICS, GAMBLIN'. ONLY A MEMBER WHO HAB ONE FEELS DA CRAVIN'.

DA METER RUNS BACKWARDS: EMPTY IZ CONTENT, FULL IZ [WITHDRAWAL | withdrawal]. FEED DA HABIT AN' IT SETTLES. ONE DOSE RARELY CLEARS WITHDRAWAL.

CRAVINGS EASE WHILE YOU SLEEP!

bodyParts.title: LIMBS AN' ORGANS
bodyParts.description:
CHARACTERS AN' MONSTERS HAB [LIMBS AND ORGANS] DAT TAKE DAMAGE SEPARATELY.

MOST BLOWS LAND ON ONE PART. [AREA | combatDamageTypes] AN' EXPLOSIVE DAMAGE SPREAD ACROSS SEVERAL.

A PART AT ZERO IZ [BROKEN] AN' HOLDS YOU BACK UNTIL IT HEALS. LOSE A HAND AN' YOU LOSE DA WEAPON IT HELD. HURT LEGS SLOW YOU DOWN.

[VITAL ORGANS | combatBodyParts] CAN BE STRUCK BY ANY BLOW, BUT A MONSTER HOLDS ON UNTIL IT IZ BADLY WEAKENED.

HEALIN' ITEMS, SPELLS AN' A NIGHT IN A BED MEND PARTS. A [CLINIC | healthSurgery] CAN REPAIR OR REPLACE DEM.

IN [BLOOD AN' OIL | combatModes] DAMAGE IZ PERMANENT: A BLADE CAN TAKE A LIMB OFF, [AUGMENT | healthAugments] AN' ALL.

OPEN DA STATUS SHEET AN' LOOK UNDER [ANATOMY] TA SEE YA BODY PART BY PART!

bodyBiologics.title: BIOLOGICS
bodyBiologics.description:
[BIOLOGICS] SHOWS WHAT GOES ON INSIDE YA BODY: VITAL SIGNS, HORMONES, DA IMMUNE SYSTEM, DA BRAIN, DA [LEY VEINS] AN' ANY [DISEASES | healthDiseases] YOU CARRY.

YA HEART AN' HORMONES REACT TA HUNGER, SLEEP, ILLNESS AN' EVEN [PREGNANCY | partyReproduction]. A BADLY [HURT LIMB | bodyParts] CAN CHOKE DA VEIN DAT RUNS THROUGH IT!

healthDiseases.title: DISEASES
healthDiseases.description:
ILLNESS SPREADS THROUGH DA AIR, BITES, TOUCH, KISSES AN' WORSE. YA OWN MEMBERS CAN PASS IT AMONG THEMSELVES, AN' YOU CAN CATCH IT FROM DA PEOPLE YOU [MEET | peopleEmpathize].

A NEW ILLNESS STAYS NAMELESS FOR A FEW DAYS. UNTIL DEN, NOBODY CAN SAY WHAT IT IZ.

HEALIN' POTIONS DO NUTTIN' AGAINST DISEASE. YOU NEED [MEDICINE], TAKEN DAY AFTER DAY. ONCE AN ILLNESS HAB A NAME, A SICK MEMBER TAKES DA RIGHT MEDICINE FROM DA BACKPACK EACH MORNIN' BY THEMSELVES. SKIP TOO MANY DAYS AN' DA CURE STARTS OVER. LEFT UNTREATED, AN ILLNESS CAN TURN INTO SOMETINK WORSE.

ILLNESS WEARS YOU DOWN BUT NEVER KILLS. BEAT ONE AN' YOU MAY BE IMMUNE, THOUGH SOME ALWAYS COME BACK.

A DOCTOR'S [DIAGNOSE] NAMES YA ILLNESSES, FOR [25 EUROS] EACH. A [NURSE | partyClasses] IN DA PARTY NAMES DEM ALL FOR FREE!

healthEpidemics.title: EPIDEMICS
healthEpidemics.description:
BEYOND SINGLE ILLNESSES, WHOLE [EPIDEMICS] ROLL ACROSS DA CONTINENT, TOWN BY TOWN, UNTIL PEOPLE RALLY AN' DA WAVE BREAKS.

AN [OUTBREAK] IZ A TRUE PATHOGEN. A [HYSTERIA] IZ A MASS PANIC, FAR LESS DEADLY BUT STRANGE: DANCIN' FEVERS, PHANTOM GASSERS AN' WORSE. YOU CATCH A HYSTERIA BY WITNESSIN' IT AN' SPREAD IT BY TALKIN' 'BOUT IT.

AN INFECTED TOWN CHANGES: MOODS SOUR, SHOPS EMPTY, GOSSIP AN' DA [NEWS | societyNews] FILL WIT IT. FOLLOW IT ALL FROM DA [EURODEMICS | hypernetEurodemics] OBSERVATORY!

healthSurgery.title: CLINICS, PROSTHETICS AN' FIELD SURGERY
healthSurgery.description:
A [CLINIC] CAN FIT, REMOVE, REPLACE OR [REPAIR] A BODY PART, OR GRAFT AN [IMPLANT | healthAugments]. DA PRICE DEPENDS ON DA PART AN' WHAT IT GIVES YOU. A CLINIC NEVER FAILS. VITAL PARTS NO CAN BE REMOVED.

REPAIR RESTORES A DAMAGED PART STILL ATTACHED, AN' CAN EVEN STASH ONE RUINED IN [BLOOD AN' OIL | combatModes]. A PART DAT CAME OFF NO CAN BE REPAIRED: FIT A NEW ONE.

DA CLINIC ALSO OFFERS [PLASTIC SURGERY | partyMetamorphosis] FOR A NEW BODY ([100 EUROS]) AN' FACE SURGERY FOR A NEW PORTRAIT ([50 EUROS]).

[FIELD SURGERY] IZ DA SAME WORK ON DA ROAD, FOR FREE. PICK A PATIENT AN' A SURGEON AN' USE ONLY PARTS YOU CARRY. IT IZ A GAMBLE: DA ODDS IZ SHOWN FIRST, AN' A SKILLED [SURGEON | progressSpecializations], A ROOF AN' GOOD WEATHER ALL HELP. A BOTCHED OPERATION WOUNDS DA PATIENT ELSEWHERE!

healthAugments.title: AUGMENTS
healthAugments.description:
DA [AUGMENTS] REGISTER SHOWS WHAT DA PARTY WEARS UNDER [FITTED], AN' EVERYTINK DAT EXISTS UNDER [CATALOGUE], SO YOU CAN READ BEFORE YOU PAY FOR DA GRAFT.

A BODY CAN ONLY TAKE SO MANY AUGMENTS. A TOUGHER [CONSTITUTION | partyAttributes] MAKES ROOM FOR MORE.

DA RIGHT AUGMENT CAN ALSO SLOW, STOP OR EVEN REVERSE A [NEED | needsOverview]!

healthWeatherBody.title: WEATHER, TEMPERATURE AN' DA BODY
healthWeatherBody.description:
DA TRAVEL CARD SHOWS DA [TEMPERATURE]. COLD AN' HEAT BOTH MAKE YOU [HUNGRY SOONER | needsHunger].

BAD [WEATHER | worldWeather] ALSO MAKES [FIELD SURGERY | healthSurgery] RISKIER!

combatBasics.title: HOW A FIGHT STARTS
combatBasics.description:
DERE IZ [NO RANDOM ENCOUNTERS]. EVERY MONSTER STANDS ON DA MAP WIT ITS [LEVEL | combatEnemyLevels] OVER ITS HEAD. WALK INTO IT TA FIGHT.

MONSTERS NEARBY MAY [JOIN THE FIGHT]. SOMETINK FAR ABOVE YA LEVEL FIGHTS ALONE.

EACH BATTLER ACTS ON ITS OWN TURN, AN' [AGILITY | partyAttributes] DECIDES WHO GOES FIRST.

A MONSTER YOU RAN FROM STAYS WOUNDED WHILE YOU REMAIN ON DA MAP. LEAVE, AN' DA MONSTERS HEAL AN' DA [CORPSES | combatCorpses] IZ GONE.

[FLEEING] ALWAYS WORKS, EXCEPT AGAINST A [BOSS], WHERE IT MAY TAKE A FEW TRIES!

combatCommands.title: DA BATTLE COMMANDS
combatCommands.description:
DA COMMAND MENU HAB [ATTACK], [SKILLS], [DEFENSE], [BACKPACK | gearBackpack], [ACTIONS], [TALK | combatTalk] AN' [RUN | combatBasics]. ALL SKILLS, MAGIC INCLUDED, SIT UNDER SKILLS.

DEFENSE CHANGES WIT WHAT YOU HOLD:
- A RANGED WEAPON TURNS IT INTO [RELOAD | combatAmmo]
- GEAR WIT A BOUND SPECIAL SKILL SHOWS DAT SKILL
- A CHARACTER PUSHED TA DA BRINK SEES DEY [HYPER | combatHyper]

[ACTIONS] OPENS A SECOND PAGE:
- [AIM | combatBodyParts]: PICK A PART OF DA BAD 'UN FOR YA NEXT BLOW
- [THROW | combatThrow]: HURL AN ITEM FROM DA PACK
- [WRESTLE | combatWrestle]: GRAB HOLD OF DA BAD 'UN

WRESTLE AN' TALK DO NO DEPEND ON CLASS AN' NEVER TAKE A [LOADOUT | progressLoadout] SLOT. A CREATURE WITOUT LANGUAGE NO CAN TALK.

MOUSE: [LEFT CLICK] AN BAD 'UN TA TARGET IT, [RIGHT CLICK] TA GO BACK. KEYS [1] TA [9] USE DA QUICK BAR: HOLD TA ARM A SLOT, RELEASE TA CAST!

combatAP.title: MP AN' AP
combatAP.description:
[MP] IZ MAGIC. SPELLS SPEND IT, AN' SOME [SUMMONS | combatSummons] FEED ON IT.

[AP] IZ MOMENTUM. BATTLE SKILLS AN' SPRINTIN' ON DA MAP DRAW FROM DA SAME METER. RUNNIN' DRAINS IT, WALKIN' SLOWLY REFILLS IT, AN' STANDIN' STILL REFILLS IT FASTER.

DA NAME TELLS YOU DA COST: [MAGIC | camelcaseMagic] IZ WRITTEN IN CamelCase AN' COSTS MP. A PLAIN WORDED [SKILL] USUALLY COSTS AP!

combatBodyParts.title: HITTIN' WHAT YOU AIM AT
combatBodyParts.description:
MONSTERS HAB LIMBS AN' ORGANS JUST LIKE YOU. [AIM | combatCommands] PICKS ONE FOR YA NEXT BLOW AN' SHOWS YA CHANCE TA HIT IT.

BIG PARTS IZ EASIER TA HIT, LIL' ONES HARDER, AN' A PART ALREADY HURT IZ EASIER STILL.

[VITAL ORGANS | bodyParts] IZ HARD TA HIT AN' ONLY FINISH A MONSTER ONCE IT IZ BADLY WEAKENED. [BLUNT | combatDamageTypes] BLOWS NEVER FINISH ONE.

BREAK A LIMB AN' YOU TAKE AWAY WHAT IT DOES. A FINAL CUTTIN', PIERCIN' OR EXPLOSIVE BLOW CAN [SEVER] IT!

combatDamageTypes.title: DAMAGE TYPES AN' PIERCIN'
combatDamageTypes.description:
EVERY ATTACK HAB A [DAMAGE TYPE]: EXPLOSIVE, PIERCIN', CUTTIN', BLUNT, AREA AN' A FEW STRANGER ONES.

CUTTIN', PIERCIN' AN' EXPLOSIVE BLOWS CAN TAKE A PART OFF. AREA AN' EXPLOSIVE DAMAGE SPREAD ACROSS DA BODY.

[BLUNT] BLOWS BREAK BONES BUT NEVER DESTROY A [VITAL ORGAN | bodyParts]. SOMEONE BEATEN DOWN WIT BLUNT BLOWS IZ LEFT [DOWNED | lawDowned] RATHER DEN DEAD.

[PIERCING] SLIPS PAST MOST DEFENCES, EVEN [DIVINE SHIELD | divineShield] AN' [MAGIC REFLECTION | magicReflection]!

combatWrestle.title: WRESTLIN'
combatWrestle.description:
ANYONE WIT A [LIMB | bodyParts] ABLE TA GRIP CAN [WRESTLE]. IT COSTS NUTTIN' AN' NEEDS NO TRAININ'.

YOU CHOOSE WHICH OF YA LIMBS TAKES HOLD, WHICH OF DEY, AN' HOW. EACH CHOICE SHOWS ITS ODDS.

A FEW OF DA HOLDS:
- [GRAPPLE]: TAKE HOLD. MOST OTHER MOVES NEED ONE FIRST
- [STRIKE]: A BLOW DAT CAN [CONCUSS | concussed] OR CAUSE [BLEEDIN' | bleeding]
- [JOINT LOCK]: [PINS | pinned] DA BAD 'UN IN PLACE
- [CHOKE]: LEAVES DEM GASPIN' FOR AIR
- [RIP]: A LONG SHOT DAT CAN TEAR DA LIMB CLEAN OFF

DA [WRESTLIN' | progressSpecializations] SPECIALIZATION MAKES YOU BETTER AT ALL OF IT, AN' A [MARTIAL ART | gearMartialArts] ADDS ITS OWN FINISHERS!

combatTalk.title: TALKIN' TA MONSTERS
combatTalk.description:
A MONSTER DAT UNDERSTANDS YOU CAN BE TALKED TA. [TALK] OPENS A PANEL WIT EACH APPROACH AN' ITS ODDS.

EVERY BAD 'UN HAB A [DISPOSITION] TOWARD YOU. HURTIN' IT SOURS DA MOOD. YA [PSI | partyAttributes] AN' [HOW YOU LOOK | gearArmor] HELP.

- [CHAT]: BUILDS RAPPORT
- [SURRENDER]: ASKS IT TA LEAVE DA FIGHT
- [JOIN DA PARTY | partyRecruiting]: NEEDS A FREE SLOT AN' A CREATURE OF YA SIZE
- [FOLLOW YOU | partyPets]: TAKES IT ALONG AS A PET
- [INSULT] AN' [THROW A STONE]: ALWAYS LAND, AN' IT WILL LIKE YOU LESS
- [PET IT]: A TALKIN' CREATURE HAB TA LIKE YOU FIRST

SOME CREATURES IZ FORCES RATHER DEN PEOPLE, [PETRODEMONS | petrodemons] ABOVE ALL, AN' NO CAN BE TALKED TA!

combatEnemyLevels.title: BAD 'UN LEVELS AN' WHERE DEY LIVE
combatEnemyLevels.description:
HOW DANGEROUS DA LAND IZ DEPENDS ON WHERE YOU STAND. SOME NATIONS IZ GENTLE PLACES TA START, OTHERS IZ NO, AN' AWAY FROM EUROPE DA WILD TENDS TA MATCH YA PARTY.

NO CREATURE BELONGS TA ONE COUNTRY ALONE. EACH NATION SIMPLY FAVOURS SOME OVER OTHERS.

MONSTERS ALSO GET STRONGER AS DA YEARS PASS.

EACH WORLD ALSO HIDES A FEW [RARITIES]: CREATURES DAT EXIST ONLY ONCE, MARKED BY A [GOLD] LEVEL TAG AN' UNUSUAL COLOURS. MEET ONE AN' IT GOES INTO DA [BESTIARY | combatBestiary]. IT NEVER APPEARS AGAIN!

combatMovementAI.title: HOW MONSTERS BEHAVE
combatMovementAI.description:
EVERY ROAMIN' MONSTER HAB ITS OWN [TEMPERAMENT]: HOW IT IDLES, HOW IT SPOTS YOU AN' WHAT IT DOES NEXT.

A GRAZER BOLTS WHEN YOU COME CLOSE. A SENTRY WATCHES ONE DIRECTION AN' CAN BE CREPT AROUND. AN AMBUSHER WAITS UNTIL YOU IZ NEAR, DEN STRIKES. A LONE PACK ANIMAL KEEPS ITS DISTANCE AN' CALLS DA OTHERS. DERE IZ MANY MORE.

MONSTERS ALSO LIVE AMONG THEMSELVES. HUNTERS CHASE PREY ACROSS DA MAP, AN' DA PREY RUNS!

combatSafety.title: DANGER WARNINGS AN' SURVIVIN' A BLOW
combatSafety.description:
A MONSTER'S LEVEL TAG WARNS YOU: WHITE IZ A FAIR FIGHT, [YELLOW] IZ TOUGH, [RED] IZ DEADLY.

IN EACH FIGHT, A CHARACTER AT FULL HEALTH SURVIVES ONE BLOW DAT WOULD HAB KILLED DEM. SOMEONE ALREADY HURT DOES NO.

NOW AN' DEN A MONSTER DAT CAN [TALK | combatTalk] MAY [SPARE YOU] AN' WALK AWAY, IF IT LIKES YOU, IF YOU IZ ON YA LAST LEGS, OR IF YOU IZ TOO WEAK TA BOTHER WIT!

combatModes.title: DIFFICULTY AN' COMBAT MODES
combatModes.description:
TWO CHOICES MADE AT [CHARACTER CREATION | partyCreation] SHAPE EVERY FIGHT.

DA [DIFFICULTY]:
- [PEACEFUL]: MONSTERS ONLY FIGHT BACK ONCE HURT, AN' NOBODY TRULY DIES
- [ROGUELITE]: DEFEAT WAKES YOU AT A RESPAWN POINT, AN' FALLEN ALLIES CAN BE REVIVED
- [PERMADEATH | partyDeath] AN' [BLOOD AND OIL]: DEATH IZ DA END, AN' ALLIES NO REVIVED IN TIME IZ LOST FOR GOOD. BLOOD AN' OIL ALSO LETS BLADES TAKE LIMBS OFF FOREVER

DA [BATTLE STYLE]:
- [TURN BATTLE]: DA CLASSIC BATTLE SCREEN
- [STRATEGIC BATTLE | combatMapBattle]: FIGHTS ON DA LIVE MAP. YOU CAN CHANGE DIS LATER IN [FIDDLY BITS | optionsMenu]

combatMapBattle.title: MAP BATTLE MODE
combatMapBattle.description:
[STRATEGIC BATTLE] PLAYS EVERY BATTLE ON DA MAP WHERE YOU STAND. CHOOSE IT AT [CHARACTER CREATION | partyCreation] OR LATER IN [FIDDLY BITS | optionsMenu], UNDER GAMEPLAY.

EVERYONE FIGHTS FROM WHERE DEY IZ. NEARBY MONSTERS JOIN IN, AN' TOWNSPEOPLE WHO LIKE YOU, OR IZ SIMPLY BRAVE, MAY TAKE YA SIDE.

[Move] REPOSITIONS DA ACTIN' BATTLER. WATER SLOWS YOU. SPEARS AN' WHIPS REACH FURTHER DEN SWORDS, BOWS AN' GUNS FURTHER STILL, AN' RANGED ATTACKS NEED A CLEAR LINE OF SIGHT.

YOU [NO CAN RUN | combatBasics] WIT A MONSTER RIGHT BESIDE YOU. STEP AWAY FIRST!

combatSummons.title: SUMMONS
combatSummons.description:
A [SUMMON] IZ A TEMPORARY EXTRA MEMBER OF DA PARTY. ONLY ONE CAN BE OUT AT A TIME, YOU COMMAND IT ON ITS TURN, AN' WHEN IT DIES IT IZ GONE.

SUMMONIN' IZ [CONVOKATION] MAGIC. EACH RITE CALLS A FAMILY OF BEINGS: DEMONS, ELEMENTALS, DRAGONS AN' MANY STRANGER TINKZ. DA SUMMON ALWAYS MATCHES DA STRENGTH OF DA FIGHT.

SOME RITES CALL WHAT YOU PREPARED: A CREATURE OR A PERSON YOU MARKED, DA LAST TINK YOU KILLED, EVEN A COMPANION YOU LOST.

A SUMMON COSTS BLOOD, MP, EUROS OR STRANGER TINKZ FOR EVERY TURN IT STAYS. WHEN YOU NO CAN PAY, IT LEAVES. [DismissSummon] SENDS IT AWAY.

OUTSIDE A FIGHT, WHAT YOU CALL WALKS BEHIND YOU FOR A WHILE AN' JOINS ANY BATTLE ON DA WAY. SEND IT HOME FROM DA [FOLLOWERS] PAGE.

A [FAMILIAR] IZ SOMETINK ELSE: SEE [FAMILIARS | partyFamiliar]!

combatArena.title: DA ARENA
combatArena.description:
DA ARENA OFFERS A [GAUNTLET] OF FIGHTS AT A LEVEL YOU PICK, A [BIOME TRIAL] AGAINST ONE LAND'S BEASTS, AN' A [BOSS RUSH].

YA PARTY IZ BROUGHT TA DA BRACKET'S LEVEL, OR YOU CAN FIELD A RANDOM ROSTER INSTEAD.

EACH WIN GROWS YA [STREAK], AN' DA PRIZES GROW WIT IT. LATER FIGHTS PIT YOU AGAINST WHOLE GROUPS. [RUNNIN' | combatBasics] FROM ANY FIGHT ENDS DA STREAK!

combatBulletHell.title: BULLET HELL SEQUENCES
combatBulletHell.description:
SOME FIGHTS BREAK INTO A [BULLET HELL]: YOU STEER A LIL' CRAFT, WEAVE THROUGH DA BAD 'UN'S FIRE AN' SHOOT BACK.

HITS ON BOTH SIDES COUNT AS REAL DAMAGE IN DA FIGHT.

SOME BAD 'UN ULTIMATES MUST BE DODGED DIS WAY BEFORE DEY LAND: DA MORE SHOTS YOU TAKE, DA HARDER DA BLOW. BULLET TIME SLOWS DA BAD 'UN FIRE. FIGHTS ON DA MAP SKIP DA DODGE AN' DA BLOW LANDS AS USUAL!

combatSpirits.title: SPIRIT BATTLERS
combatSpirits.description:
FALLEN BAD 'UNS DO NO LINGER AS SPIRITS FOR YOU TA FIELD LATER.

TA FIGHT BESIDE A MONSTER, [TALK IT INTO JOININ' | combatTalk] OR CALL ONE WIT A [SUMMON | combatSummons]!

combatMimic.title: MIMICRY
combatMimic.description:
[MIMIC SKILLS] LET YOU BORROW OTHER BODIES. STEAL AN BAD 'UN'S SKILLS, WEAR ITS FACE, TURN ITS OWN LAST TRICK BACK ON IT, OR BECOME IT ENTIRELY. YOU CAN EVEN COPY A COMPANION.

COPIES FADE WHEN DA BATTLE ENDS. [MUTATION] IZ DA EXCEPTION: IT FUSES STRANGE CREATURES INTO YA BODY FOR GOOD.

TAKIN' A BODY MEANS TAKIN' ITS [LIMBS | bodyParts], WHICH CHANGES WHAT YOU CAN HOLD AN' WHERE YOU CAN BE HURT.

A [MIMIC | partyClasses] BY CLASS PICKS UP NEW TRICKS AS DEY GROW, AN' SOMETIMES KEEPS A SKILL AN BAD 'UN USED ON DEM!

combatThrow.title: THROWIN' TINKZ
combatThrow.description:
YOU CAN THROW ITEMS, WEAPONS AN' ARMOUR. LIGHT TINKZ FLY FAR, HEAVY ONES DROP SHORT.

WHAT YOU THROW STAYS WHERE IT LANDS, READY TA BE PICKED UP, UNLESS IT FALLS SOMEWHERE DAT DESTROYS IT!

combatCorpses.title: CORPSES AN' REWARDS
combatCorpses.description:
AFTER A WIN, DA [REWARD POPUP] SHOWS EVERYTINK YOU EARNED: ITEMS IN DEY [RARITY | gearRarity] COLOURS, MONEY, EXPERIENCE AN' [KNOWLEDGE | progressKnowledge].

DA DEAD LEAVE [CORPSES] ON DA MAP UNTIL YOU LEAVE. A MONSTER YOU BEAT IZ GONE FOR GOOD. ONE YOU FLED FROM WAITS WHERE IT WAZ, STILL WOUNDED.

A [BOSS] DIES ONCE FOR DA WHOLE WORLD, IN EVERY SAVEGAME OF IT. DA KILL GOES INTO DA [HISTORICAL ARCHIVE | societyHistory].

A [PETRODEMON | petrodemons] PAYS IN CRUDE OIL.

WINNIN' LIFTS DA SPIRITS OF EVERYONE WHO FOUGHT, AN' EVERY CREATURE YOU FACE GOES INTO DA [BESTIARY]!

elementsOverview.title: ELEMENTS: HOW DEY WORK
elementsOverview.description:
NINE ELEMENTS RUN THROUGH EVERY FIGHT: [PHYSICAL | elementPhysical], [FIRE | elementFire], [ICE | elementIce], [THUNDER | elementThunder], [WATER | elementWater], [PETRO | petro], [WIND | elementWind], [SACRED | elementSacred] AN' [CURSED | elementCursed].

EVERY CREATURE HAB ITS WEAKNESSES AN' RESISTANCES. SOME IZ IMMUNE, AN' A FEW EVEN HEAL FROM WHAT SHOULD HURT DEM.

DA BATTLE HUD SHOWS DA MAIN WEAKNESSES OF DA BAD 'UN IN FRONT OF YOU, AN' DA [BESTIARY] TELLS DA WHOLE STORY.

STATES CHANGE TINKZ: A [WET | wet] TARGET FEARS THUNDER MORE DEN FIRE, AN' AN [OILY | oily] ONE IZ WAITIN' FOR A SPARK!

elementPhysical.title: ELEMENT: PHYSICAL
elementPhysical.description:
EDGES, POINTS, WEIGHT AN' FISTS. MOST WEAPON ATTACKS IZ PHYSICAL.

PHYSICAL SKILLS CAN [BREAK GUARDS | guardBroken], [PIN | pinned] OR [UNBALANCE | unbalanced] A FOE. WHETHER A BLOW CAN SEVER DEPENDS ON ITS [DAMAGE TYPE | combatDamageTypes].

[ARMOUR | gearArmor] STOPS IT. HEAVY ARMOUR PROTECTS MORE AN' LOOKS FEARSOME, LIGHT ARMOUR HELPS YOU STAY UNSEEN.

GHOSTS AN' MOST OOZES SHRUG IT OFF!

elementFire.title: ELEMENT: FIRE
elementFire.description:
FIRE OFTEN LEAVES A TARGET [BURNED | burned], AN' A BURN DOES NO GO OUT ON ITS OWN.

[OILY | oily] AN' [COLD | cold] TARGETS GO UP FAST, AN' PLANTS FEAR IT. [WET | wet] TARGETS AN' MOST REPTILES SHRUG MUCH OF IT OFF. FIRE ELEMENTALS AN' PHOENIXES ABSORB IT!

elementIce.title: ELEMENT: ICE
elementIce.description:
ICE LEAVES A TARGET [COLD | cold], OR [FROZEN | freeze] SOLID AN' UNABLE TA ACT.

A COLD TARGET BURNS ALL DA BETTER, SO ICE SETS UP [FIRE | elementFire]!

elementThunder.title: ELEMENT: THUNDER
elementThunder.description:
THUNDER LEAVES A TARGET [STATIC | static], OR [PARALYSED | paralysis] AN' UNABLE TA ACT.

[WET | wet] AN' [FLOATIN' | floating] TARGETS SUFFER MOST. ONE ALREADY STATIC HOLDS UP BETTER.

MACHINES, DRONES AN' ARMOURED KNIGHTS USUALLY DREAD IT!

elementWater.title: ELEMENT: WATER
elementWater.description: WATER LEAVES DA TARGET [WET | wet]: WEAK TA [THUNDER | elementThunder], SAFE FROM [FIRE | elementFire]. IT DEALS LIL' DAMAGE!

petro.title: ELEMENT: PETRO
petro.description:
OIL, AN' WHATEVER COMES OUT OF DA GROUND WIT IT.

PETRO IZ DA ELEMENT OF DA [PETRODEMONS | petrodemons]. DEY NO CAN BE TALKED TA, NO CAN BE HURT BY PETRO AN' FEAR [FIRE | elementFire]. DEY LEAVE OIL BEHIND.

OIL MATTERS BEYOND BATTLE TOO: IT PRICES [POST | societyMail], FEEDS DA [PETRODEMON SUMMON | combatSummons] AN' TRADES ON DA [STOCK MARKET | econStocks].

SOME PETRO ATTACKS LEAVE DA TARGET [OILY | oily], READY TA CATCH FIRE!

elementWind.title: ELEMENT: WIND
elementWind.description:
AIR, PRESSURE AN' MOVIN' FORCE. WIND OFTEN LIFTS DA TARGET INTO [FLOATIN' | floating], AN' NOW AN' DEN LEAVES IT [UNBALANCED | unbalanced].

MOST BIRDS RIDE IT OUT WIT EASE!

elementSacred.title: ELEMENT: SACRED
elementSacred.description:
DA BANE OF DEMONS AN' DA UNDEAD: SKELETONS, GHOSTS AN' VAMPIRES ALL FEAR IT. ANGELS TEND TA RESIST IT, AN' SOME SACRED BEINGS DRINK IT IN.

SACRED WORKINGS MAY [SILENCE | silence] OR [BLIND | blind] DA TARGET, AN' SOME LEAVE A [DEATH MARK | deathMark]!

elementCursed.title: ELEMENT: CURSED
elementCursed.description:
ROT, RUIN AN' DRAININ'. DA UNDEAD WIELD IT MORE DEN ANYTINK ELSE, AN' SOME CURSED WORKINGS STEAL HP OR MP FROM DEY TARGET.

MANY HUMANS AN' GOBLINS IZ WEAK TA IT. ROBOTS AN' ANGELS HOLD FIRM!

worldMapPage.title: DA WORLD MAP
worldMapPage.description:
DA WORLD MAP IZ ALL OF EUROPE, EACH SQUARE A WHOLE REGION. CROSSIN' ONE TAKES TIME, LESS IN A VEHICLE.

[M] OPENS AN' CLOSES DA FULLSCREEN MAP. DERE, [DRAG] TA PAN AN' USE DA [WHEEL] OR [Q] / [E] TA ZOOM. DA CORNER MINIMAP CAN BE SWITCHED IN DA TRAVEL FIDDLY BITS.

HOVER OR PICK A SQUARE TA LEARN 'BOUT IT. [SHOW MAP] LETS YOU LOOK AT A SQUARE BEFORE YOU GO, AN' YOU CAN LEAVE A [NOTE] ON IT, ALSO WIT [RIGHT CLICK] OR [R1]. ABOARD A VEHICLE, CLICK A NAMED PLACE TA SET OFF FOR IT.

PRESS DA [ACTION BUTTON] FOR DA TRAVEL MENU:
- [VISIT] DA SQUARE YOU STAND ON
- [INVESTIGATE] AN ADVENTURE
- [LIMINAL WALK] IT ON FOOT IN DA [3D WORLD | worldVoxelWalk]
- [FORAGE], OR [MAKE A CAMP | needsCamp]

[T] RETURNS TA DA LAST LOCAL MAP, OR ENTERS DA SQUARE YOU STAND ON.

MANY GREAT CITIES, LONDON, PARIS, ROME AN' OTHERS, IZ [TRAPPED IN A SPACETIME BUBBLE]. YOU NO CAN ENTER DEM. SQUARES MARKED [???] HOLD [ADVENTURES | worldAdventures]!

worldProcedural.title: PROCEDURAL MAPS
worldProcedural.description:
ALMOST EVERY PLACE YOU VISIT IZ [GENERATED] FROM YA WORLD. RETURN TA A SQUARE AN' YOU FIND IT JUST AS YOU LEFT IT.

DA [BIOME | worldBiomes] DECIDES HOW DA LAND LOOKS AN' WHAT GROWS DERE. ROADS WANDER AN' CROSS, RIVERS AN' COASTLINES RUN ON INTO DA NEXT SQUARE, AN' HANDMADE CORNERS AN' [TERRAIN FEATURES | worldTerrain] IZ SCATTERED ALONG DA WAY.

WALK OFF DA EDGE TA STEP INTO DA [NEIGHBOURING SQUARE]!

worldBiomes.title: BIOMES
worldBiomes.description:
DA [BIOME] OF A SQUARE SHAPES EVERYTINK 'BOUT IT: DA LAND, DA CREATURES, DA MUSIC, DA [WEATHER | worldWeather] AN' WHAT YOU CAN [FORAGE | needsForage].

SOME BIOMES IZ RARE AN' STRANGE, LIKE SPIRIT WOODS AN' CRYSTAL FIELDS, AN' CERTAIN CREATURES LIVE NOWHERE ELSE.

ROOFED PLACES, CELLARS, TEMPLES, CAVES AN' DUNGEONS, IZ REACHED THROUGH A [STRUCTURE ENTRANCE | worldStructures]!

worldStructures.title: STRUCTURES UNDER DA MAP
worldStructures.description:
ENTRANCES ON DA MAP IZ [WALKED INTO], NO PRESSED. EACH ONE ALWAYS LEADS TA DA SAME PLACE.

- [STAIRS DOWN]: CELLARS, CRYPTS, MINES, FORGOTTEN LIBRARIES AN' MUCH MORE. REAL RARELY, A [HOLY PATRON BUNKER | galaxyPatrons]
- [STAIRS UP]: TINKZ ONCE BUILT ABOVE GROUND AN' SINCE BURIED
- [CAVE]: DENS, FROZEN CAVES, CRYSTAL GROTTOES AN' STRANGER HOLLOWS
- [GRATE]: A TOWN'S SEWERS
- [HATCH]: FOUND ONLY ON A PATRON'S SQUARE, WHERE RETIRED COMPANIONS LIVE

DA LAND ABOVE HINTS AT WHAT LIES BELOW: ICE HIDES FROZEN CAVES, A GRAVEYARD HIDES CATACOMBS!

worldHouses.title: HOUSES, INNS AN' SHOPS
worldHouses.description:
[DOORS] OPEN ONTO REAL BUILDINGS: HOUSES, INNS, [SHOPS | econShops] AN' TOWER BLOCKS, SOME WIT SEVERAL FLOORS. A DOOR ALWAYS OPENS ONTO DA SAME PLACE.

ONLY [HOMES] LOCK, AN' ONLY AT NIGHT. SHOPS NEVER DO. A LOCKED DOOR CAN BE [PICKED | gamesLockpick], AN' A DOOR YOU FORCE STAYS OPEN FOR A WHILE!

worldTerrain.title: WORKIN' DA TERRAIN
worldTerrain.description:
FACE A TERRAIN FEATURE AN' PRESS DA ACTION BUTTON TA WORK IT.

- [TREES]: FELLED WIT AN [AXE] IN YA PACK
- [ROCKS]: MINED WIT A [WAR PICK], A HEAVY WEAPON OR A [CHIPPED PICKAXE]
- [PLANTS]: PICKED BY HAND
- ALMOST ANYTINK ELSE CAN BE [DISMANTLED]

YOU GAIN [CRAFTING MATERIALS], AN' MININ' NOW AN' DEN TURNS UP AN [INGOT].

FORAGIN' ALWAYS YIELDS PLANT MATTER, AN' OFTEN SOMETINK TA EAT. DA LAND DECIDES WHAT: CHANTERELLES IN A FOREST, CLOUDBERRIES ON DA TUNDRA, DATES IN DA DESERT, GLOWCAPS UNDERGROUND. TRAININ' [FORAGIN' | progressSpecializations] HELPS.

[ALIEN | galaxyLanding] WORLDS OFFER NUTTIN' TA FORAGE, BUT DEY TENTACLE GROWTHS CAN BE CUT FOR MEAT.

WHAT YOU FELL OR WORK [STAYS GONE]!

worldDungeon.title: DA DUNGEON AN' DA TOWER
worldDungeon.description:
ONE GREAT DUNGEON RISES IN EVERY WORLD, ITS SHAPE DIFFERENT EACH TIME.

ABOVE GROUND DA [TOWER] CLIMBS FLOOR AFTER FLOOR. EVERY SO OFTEN YOU REACH AN [ELEVATOR HALL], AN' FROM DERE DA ELEVATOR AN' DA FLOOR LIST TAKE YOU BACK TA ANY FLOOR YOU HAB ALREADY REACHED. FLOORS YOU HAB NO SEEN SHOW AS [???].

BELOW GROUND LIES DA [LOWER TOWER], A LONG DESCENT THROUGH BURIED [STRUCTURES | worldStructures]. DOWN DERE DA NUMBERS RUN DA OTHER WAY!

worldPuzzles.title: PUZZLES
worldPuzzles.description:
MANY MAPS HIDE PUZZLES WAITIN' TA BE SOLVED:

- [BLOCKS] TA PUSH INTO PLACE, WIT SHRINES TA UNDO OR RESET
- [PRESSURE PLATES], LEVERS AN' GATES DAT OPEN ONLY IN DA RIGHT COMBINATION
- [ICE FLOORS], ARROWS AN' CONVEYORS DAT CARRY YOU ALONG
- [CRYSTAL SWITCHES] DAT TURN WALLS SOLID OR OPEN
- [TORCHES] TA LIGHT, SOMETIMES AGAINST DA CLOCK

AN' STRANGER TINKZ STILL: WARP PADS, [CRACKABLE WALLS | worldDigging], BEAMS OF LIGHT, CLONES DAT COPY YA MOVES!

worldFog.title: FOG OF WAR
worldFog.description:
[FOG OF WAR] IZ AN OPTION, [OFF] AT DA START. TURN IT ON IN DA GAMEPLAY TAB OF [FIDDLY BITS | optionsMenu].

WIT IT ON, DA MAP IZ HIDDEN UNTIL YOU EXPLORE IT. YOU SEE IN DA DIRECTION YOU FACE, SO TURNIN' IZ HOW YOU LOOK AROUND, AN' WALLS AN' DOORS BLOCK YA SIGHT. GROUND YOU HAB UNCOVERED IZ REMEMBERED.

IN SOME BUILDINGS YOU ONLY EVER SEE DA ROOM YOU IZ IN, AN' WHILE YOU [DIVE | worldMovement] DA DRY LAND GOES DARK!

worldDigging.title: DIGGIN' AN' SECRET DOORS
worldDigging.description:
SOME WALLS IZ [CRACKED]. HOLD DA RIGHT TOOL, INTERACT, AN' A DEAD END BECOMES A WAY THROUGH. IN DA 3D WORLD DA [PICK | worldVoxelDigging] DIGS THROUGH DA GROUND.

[SECRET DOORS] LOOK LIKE PLAIN WALL UNTIL YOU TOUCH DEM.

A LOCKED DOOR OFFERS TWO WAYS IN:
- [LOCKPICK | gamesLockpick]: A QUIET PUZZLE DAT NEEDS [LOCKPICKS]
- [BASH]: A TEST OF STRENGTH

A [SKELETON KEY] OPENS IT OUTRIGHT. BREAKIN' IN COUNTS AS A [CRIME | lawCrime].

SOME DOORS LET YOU [PEEK] AT DA ROOM BEYOND BEFORE YOU DECIDE!

worldMovement.title: WATER, CLIMBIN' AN' BRIDGES
worldMovement.description:
FACE WATER AN' PRESS DA ACTION BUTTON FOR DA [WATER MENU]:
- [SWIM]
- [FISH | gamesFishing] WIT A ROD
- [SURF | gamesSurfing] WIT A SURFBOARD
- [DIVE] WIT A DIVIN' SUIT
- [DRINK]
- TAKE A [BOAT | vehicleBoat]

SWIMMIN' LEAVES DA WHOLE PARTY CLEANER, A FINE WAY TA KEEP UP [HYGIENE | needsHygiene]. SWIM TOO LONG AN' YOU RUN OUT OF BREATH, ESPECIALLY ON AN EMPTY STOMACH ([HUNGER | needsHunger]). DA [SWIMMIN' | progressSpecializations] SPECIALIZATION LETS YOU GO FURTHER.

FRESH WATER EASES HUNGER. SEA WATER IZ [SALT]: DRINKIN' IT LEAVES EVERYONE SICK WIT [NAUSEA | nausea].

ON DA OPEN SEA, [DIVE] TAKES YOU DOWN TA DA SEABED AN' [RESURFACE] BRINGS YOU BACK.

[CLIMBABLE] TERRAIN ASKS BEFORE YOU CLIMB. [SEATS] AN' BENCHES CAN BE SAT ON, AN' IN A PLACE DAT SERVES FOOD YOU CAN [ORDER FOOD] FROM YA TABLE. HOLD A DIRECTION TA STAND UP.

[BRIDGES] CAN BE CROSSED OVER OR PASSED UNDER, DEPENDIN' ON HOW YOU APPROACH DEM!

worldWeather.title: WEATHER, TIME AN' SEASONS
worldWeather.description:
DA CLOCK STARTS ON YA WORLD'S [STARTIN' DATE | setupStartDate], 1 JANUARY 2001 BY DEFAULT. TIME ONLY MOVES WHEN SOMETINK HAPPENS: IT CREEPS FORWARD AS YOU WALK, STOPS WHEN YOU STAND STILL, AN' LEAPS AHEAD WHEN YOU SLEEP, WAIT, [FORAGE | needsForage], WORK OR TRAVEL.

[WEATHER] FOLLOWS DA SEASON, DA HOUR AN' DA COUNTRY YOU IZ IN. COLD BRINGS SNOW, AN' RAIN SOMETIMES TURNS INTO STORMS. CROSSIN' INTO ANOTHER COUNTRY ON DA [WORLD MAP | worldMapPage] CAN BRING A CHANGE OF SKY.

DA SCREEN TINTS WIT DA TIME OF DAY AN' DA [TEMPERATURE | healthWeatherBody]: BLUE IN DA COLD, RED IN DA HEAT!

worldDreams.title: DREAMS
worldDreams.description:
A LONG SLEEP CAN TURN INTO A [DREAM]. EVERY DREAM IZ DIFFERENT AN' STRANGE.

- [WASD] WALKS, DA [MOUSE] LOOKS, [SPACE] JUMPS. [DOUBLE TAP] JUMP WHILE STANDIN' TA [TAKE OFF]. HOLD IT TA CLIMB, [CTRL] TA SINK
- DA [ACTION BUTTON] USES DA WEAPON IN YA RIGHT HAND. DA [WHEEL] STEPS THROUGH OTHERS
- TOUCHIN' ANYTINK ALIVE MOVES YOU TA [ANOTHER DREAM]
- HOLES HAB [NO FLOOR], AN' FALLIN' FAR ENOUGH WAKES YOU

EACH DREAM HAB ITS OWN [LAWS].

GOING WITOUT [SLEEP | needsSleep] CHANGES WHAT YOU DREAM. DA LONGER YOU STAY AWAKE, DA LESS DA DREAM FEELS LIKE YA.

DREAMS HAB [NO END]. YOU MAY WAKE UP KNOWIN' SOMETINK NEW!

worldAdventures.title: ADVENTURES ON DA MAP
worldAdventures.description:
SOME WORLD MAP SQUARES HAB A [???] MARKER. STAND ON IT, OR FACE IT, AN' [INVESTIGATE] TA PLAY A BRANCHIN' ADVENTURE WRITTEN FOR DAT PLACE.

IT MAY END IN TREASURE, A FIGHT, A MINIGAME, AN [AUGMENT | healthAugments], A SHIFT IN [FACTION STANDIN' | peopleFactions], TROUBLE WIT DA LAW ([CRIME | lawCrime]), OR NUTTIN' AT ALL.

YA [LEADER | partyBasics] GOES IN, AN' SOME PATHS OPEN ONLY TA A LEADER OF DA RIGHT [TEMPERAMENT]. EACH SQUARE CAN BE PLAYED ONLY ONCE!

worldBologna.title: BOLOGNA
worldBologna.description:
[BOLOGNA] IZ MAPPED STREET BY STREET AS ONE SEAMLESS CITY.

EVERY BUILDIN' CAN BE ENTERED. MOST IZ HOMES; SOME IZ [SHOPS AN' INNS | worldHouses].

DA CITY IZ ALIVE: TOWNSPEOPLE, BOLOGNESI BORN DERE, ANIMALS ON DA PAVEMENTS AN' IN DA PARKS, BIRDS ON DA ROOFTOPS!

worldPlatformer.title: PLATFORMER MAPS
worldPlatformer.description:
ON A [PLATFORM] STAGE DA MAP BECOMES A SIDE SCROLLER: [left] AN' [right] WALK, [SPACE] JUMPS, [shift] RUNS, AN' JUMPIN' AGAINST A WALL [KICKS OFF] IT.

CLIMB LADDERS WIT [up]. YA COMPANIONS FOLLOW CLOSE BEHIND!

worldFlying.title: FLYIN'
worldFlying.description:
YOU FLY LIKE AN [AIRSHIP]: ANY DIRECTION, OVER ALMOST EVERYTINK. [CONFIRM] LANDS YOU, AN' SO DOES LEAVIN' DA MAP.

IT COMES FROM SKILLS. [FLY] WORKS ONLY ON DA [WORLD MAP | worldMapPage]. [WING WANDER] LIFTS YOU AN' [EARTH EBB] BRINGS YOU DOWN. DA [FLYIN' BROOM | vehicleBroom] IZ A VEHICLE AN' NEEDS NO SKILL TA FLY!

worldConnections.title: HOW MAPS CONNECT
worldConnections.description: DA GAME TRACKS HOW EVERY MAP CONNECTS TA DA OTHERS. IT IZ HIDDEN, AN' DA [AUTO EXPLORER | partyAutoIdle] USES IT TA FIND ITS WAY!

worldTreasure.title: CHESTS AN' TREASURE ROOMS
worldTreasure.description:
WHAT WAITS IN A CHEST DEPENDS ON HOW STRONG YA PARTY IZ ([MEDIAN LEVEL | craftLoot]), HOW DANGEROUS DA PLACE IZ AN' DA [BIOME | worldBiomes] AROUND IT. AN EMPTIED CHEST [STAYS EMPTY], IN EVERY SAVEGAME OF DAT WORLD.

SOME ENTRANCES LEAD TA [TREASURE ROOMS], HANDMADE VAULTS DAT IZ ALWAYS WAITIN' BEHIND DA SAME DOOR!

worldTechTree.title: RESEARCH AN' DISCOVERY
worldTechTree.description:
SEVERAL TREES OF DISCOVERY, FROM PHYSICS AN' ASTRONOMY TA ALCHEMISTRY, ARCANE AN' TECHNOMAGICA. A WORLD WITOUT MAGIC HIDES DA MAGICAL ONES, A WORLD GIVEN WHOLLY TA MAGIC HIDES DA SCIENCES.

DA SCIENCES FOLLOW REAL PROGRESS FORWARD FROM 2001. DA MAGICAL TREES FOLLOW DA REDISCOVERY OF LOST MAGIC, AN' [THEOTECNICAL] FOLLOWS DA [VATICAN | vaticanEmpire] REBUILDIN' ITS FAITH AROUND ENGINES. EACH TREE HAB STRANGE FRINGE BRANCHES TOO.

RESEARCHIN' A NODE CONSUMES [CRAFTING MATERIALS] AN' GIVES SOME BACK REFINED. DA WORLD REMEMBERS WHICH [LEADER | partyBasics] GOT DERE FIRST.

A NODE CAN RAISE [STATS | partyAttributes] FOR GOOD, FOR YA MAIN CHARACTERS IN EVERY SAVEGAME OF DA WORLD. ITS MONEY, EXPERIENCE AN' ITEMS GO ONLY TA DA PARTY DAT DISCOVERS IT FIRST!

travelOverview.title: FAST TRAVEL
travelOverview.description:
[BUS STOPS] AN' BUS SIGNS OPEN DA TRAVEL SCREEN. VEHICLES AN' SOME OTHER PLACES OPEN IT FOR DEY OWN TRANSPORT. YOU PICK DA [DESTINATION]; WHAT OPENED DA SCREEN DECIDES HOW YOU GO. EACH STOP SHOWS HOW TOUGH DA [BAD 'UNS | combatEnemyLevels] IZ AROUND IT.

BY BUS, TRAIN, TAXI, CAMPER OR CAR YOU RIDE A [TRAVEL MAP] WHILE A [COUNTDOWN] RUNS, EVEN THROUGH MENUS AN' FIGHTS. AT ZERO YOU HAB ARRIVED: STEP OFF TA REACH DA PLACE. OTHER TRANSPORTS TAKE YOU STRAIGHT DERE.

[SLEEPIN' | needsSleep], WAITIN' OR [FORAGIN' | needsForage] ON DA WAY MAKES DA TRIP PASS FASTER. DA COUNTDOWN FOLLOWS DA REAL CLOCK, SO A JOURNEY LEFT STASHED FOR LONG ENOUGH MAY ALREADY BE OVER.

AT DA END OF A TRIP BY VEHICLE YOU CAN WALK OUT ONTO DA GROUND OR STAY ON DA WORLD MAP. DA VEHICLE IZ PARKED BESIDE YOU.

SEE ALSO [TICKETS AN' FARE DODGIN' | travelTickets] AN' [PLACES OF YA OWN | travelOwnPlaces]!

travelModes.title: DA THIRTY WAYS TA TRAVEL
travelModes.description:
DOZENS OF WAYS TA TRAVEL, EACH TRADIN' MONEY AGAINST TIME. EACH ONE SERVES ITS OWN PLACES: DA BUS REACHES EVERY TOWN, TRAINS AN' HELICOPTERS ONLY PLACES WIT A STATION OR A PAD.

- [WALKING] IZ FREE AN' SLOW. A [BICYCLE | vehicleBike] OR A [HORSE] IZ QUICKER. [CAR SHARING] AN' DA [CAMPER | vehicleCamper] COST FUEL INSTEAD OF MONEY
- [BUS], [TRAIN], [TAXI], [BOAT] AN' [FERRY] IZ DA EVERYDAY FARES
- [FLIGHTS], [LIMOUSINES] AN' [PRIVATE JETS] IZ FAST AN' EXPENSIVE. [CRUISES], [BALLOONS] AN' [ZEPPELINS] IZ SLOW AN' DEAR
- DEN DA EXOTIC ONES: [MAGIC CARPETS], [DRAGONS], [TELEPORT CIRCLES], DA [HYPERMETRO | topicHypermetroTrain], [WORMHOLES], [TIME MACHINES] AN' MORE

DA FURTHER YOU GO AN' DA GRANDER DA RIDE, DA MORE IT COSTS!

vehiclesOverview.title: OWNIN' A VEHICLE
vehiclesOverview.description:
A VEHICLE IZ YA WHEN YOU HOLD ITS [ITEM]: DA KEY, DA DEED OR DA BROOM. DAT PUTS IT IN DA [VEHICLES] MENU. MOUNTS NEED NO ITEM: ANY COMPANION MARKED RIDABLE ON DA PETS PAGE CAN BE [RIDDEN | partyRiding].

VEHICLES STAY [PARKED IN THE WORLD] WHERE YOU LEFT DEM.

WALK UP TA ONE TA OPEN ITS MENU. DEPENDIN' ON DA VEHICLE YOU CAN [DRIVE | vehicleDriving], [FAST TRAVEL | travelOverview], STEP INSIDE, USE ITS STORAGE, [REFUEL | vehicleFuel], [REPAIR | vehicleRepair] IT, PLAY DA RADIO, [MAKE CAMP | needsCamp] OR PICK UP A BIKE OR BROOM!

vehicleCamper.title: VEHICLE: DA CAMPER
vehicleCamper.description:
DA LARGEST VEHICLE AN' A HOME ON WHEELS: BEDS, STORAGE AN' A WALK IN INTERIOR. IT REFUELS AT ANY ROADSIDE PUMP AN' MOVES FASTER ALONG ROADS.

[FAST TRAVEL | travelOverview] BY CAMPER COSTS [FUEL | vehicleFuel], NO MONEY. YOU CAN ALSO [DRIVE IT IN 3D | vehicleDriving].

DA [WORKSHOP | vehicleUpgrades] CAN FIT IT TA FLOAT AN' DIVE, OR TA FLY. IN DA 3D WORLD, [C] DIVES AN' SURFACES AN' [F] TAKES OFF AN' LANDS!

vehicleCar.title: VEHICLE: DA CAR
vehicleCar.description:
SMALLER DEN DA CAMPER AN' QUICKER ON A JOURNEY. IT HAB A LIL' INTERIOR AN' A BOOT, REFUELS AT ANY PUMP AN' MOVES FASTER ALONG ROADS. [FAST TRAVEL | travelOverview] BY CAR COSTS [FUEL | vehicleFuel], NO MONEY.

ANY [PARKED] CAR CAN BE [STOLEN]:
1. FACE IT AN' PRESS DA ACTION BUTTON.
2. CHOOSE TA STEAL IT.
3. BEAT DA [LOCKPICKIN' MINIGAME | gamesLockpick], WHICH NEEDS A [LOCKPICK]. A [SKELETON KEY] OPENS IT OUTRIGHT AN' IZ USED UP.

SUCCEED AN' DA KEYS, AN' DA CAR, IZ YA. TAKE DA KEYS FROM A DRIVER, FROM A [DOWNED BODY | lawDowned] OR OUT OF A POCKET, AN' DEY CAR OPENS WITOUT A FIGHT.

FAIL DA LOCK, OR LET DA OWNER SEE YOU DRIVE OFF, AN' YOU IZ CHARGED WIT [VEHICLE THEFT | roadTraffic]!

vehicleBike.title: VEHICLE: DA BIKE
vehicleBike.description:
PEDAL POWERED, SO IT NEEDS [NO FUEL]. NIMBLE ON LOCAL MAPS, FASTER ALONG ROADS, AN' LIGHT ENOUGH TA PICK UP AN' CARRY.

IT STILL WEARS OUT AN' NEEDS [REPAIRS | vehicleRepair] NOW AN' DEN. [FAST TRAVEL | travelOverview] BY BIKE COSTS A LIL' FARE!

vehicleBroom.title: VEHICLE: DA FLYIN' BROOM
vehicleBroom.description:
NEEDS [NO FUEL], WORKS INDOORS, AN' TUCKS INTO YA [PACK | gearBackpack] LIKE ANY OTHER ITEM.

IT [FLIES] OVER EVERYTINK: WALLS, WATER, CLIFFS. IT LANDS ON ANYTINK YOU COULD STAND ON, ROOFTOPS AN' BRIDGES INCLUDED.

ROADS MAKE IT NO FASTER!

vehicleBoat.title: VEHICLE: DA BOAT
vehicleBoat.description:
AN INFLATABLE DINGHY. NO FUEL, NO STORAGE, [OPEN WATER] ONLY. YOU CAN [FISH | gamesFishing] FROM IT.

KEEP IT PATCHED: A BURST HULL OR LOST OARS LEAVE YOU ADRIFT. REPAIRS IZ DONE FROM DA [VEHICLES | vehicleRepair] MENU.

DA WHOLE PARTY CLIMBS ABOARD, WIT DA [PET | partyPets] IN DA STERN!

vehicleStarship.title: VEHICLE: DA STARSHIP
vehicleStarship.description:
A SHIP FOR DA STARS, WIT A HUGE TANK AN' A FULL WALK IN INTERIOR. IT [CANNOT] REFUEL AT A ROADSIDE PUMP.

EVERY WORLD GIVES IT A LOOK OF ITS OWN, WHICH YOU CAN RESHAPE WIT [CHANGE APPEARANCE | galaxyShip].

IT NEEDS [NO DRIVER]. YOU FLY IT FROM DA [STAR MAP | galaxyOverview]!

vehicleFuel.title: FUEL
vehicleFuel.description:
DA [CAMPER | vehicleCamper], DA [CAR | vehicleCar] AN' DA [STARSHIP | vehicleStarship] BURN FUEL. DA BIKE, DA BROOM AN' DA BOAT DO NO.

BUY FUEL AT [PUMPS]. ITS PRICE RISES AN' FALLS WIT DA WORLD'S [OIL MARKET]. DA STARSHIP NO CAN USE A ROADSIDE PUMP.

WATCH DA GAUGE WHILE YOU DRIVE. RUNNIN' DRY [STRANDS YOU]!

vehicleRepair.title: VEHICLE DAMAGE AN' REPAIR
vehicleRepair.description:
VEHICLES WEAR DOWN PART BY PART. SOME PARTS IZ [CRITICAL]: BREAK DA ENGINE, DA BRAKES OR DA STEERIN' AN' YOU IZ GOING NOWHERE. OTHERS ONLY MAKE DA RIDE WORSE.

DAMAGE COMES FROM WHAT YOU HIT, AN' A CRASH WIT ANOTHER VEHICLE HURTS DA MOST, UNLESS YOU SWERVE IN TIME.

REPAIRS CONSUME [CRAFTING MATERIALS]. WHILE RIDIN', DA VEHICLE'S CONDITION SHOWS AS AN [HP BAR] ON DA PARTY HUD!

vehicleUpgrades.title: DA WORKSHOP
vehicleUpgrades.description:
VEHICLES IZ IMPROVED WIT [CRAFTING MATERIALS] IN DA [UPGRADE] TAB OF DEY [REPAIR SCREEN | vehicleRepair].

EVERYONE'S LIFE GOES ON WHENEVER TIME DOES, EVEN WHILE YOU SLEEP.

peopleSettlements.description:
EVERY TOWN TRACKS HOW [PROSPEROUS], [SAFE] AN' [HAPPY] IT IZ. JOBS, CRIME, DA NATION'S FORTUNES AN' HOW [WANTED | lawCrime] YOU IZ ALL PUSH ON IT.

peoplePolitics.title: POLITICS
peoplePolitics.description:

3. [RUN FOR OFFICE | powersElections] IN A TOWN, A NATION OR A HYPERPOWER.

peopleFactions.description:
DA WORLD IZ SPLIT AMONG MANY [FACTIONS], AN' EACH OF YA CHARACTERS HAB DEY OWN STANDIN' WIT EACH ONE, FROM HATED TA REVERED. IT SHIFTS WIT DA [CONTRACTS | econQuests] YOU TAKE, DA [CRIMES | lawCrime] YOU COMMIT AN' DA SIDES YOU CHOOSE.

IT CAN SWEAR ALLEGIANCE TA A HYPERPOWER AN' LATER STAND ALONE AGAIN. ITS STANDIN' IZ DA FEELIN' OF DA WHOLE PARTY, SO NO SINGLE COMPANION CAN SWING IT. FOUNDIN' IT ALSO BRINGS YA TEAM INTO YA [POLITICAL PARTY | powersOwnParty]!

peopleONU.title: DA ASSEMBLY
peopleONU.description:
EVERY [HYPERPOWER | peoplePolitics] HOLDS A SEAT IN DA ASSEMBLY, WHICH MEETS IN [BRUSSELS]: WALK INTO DA CHAMBER TA OPEN DA LOBBY. DA [CHAMBER] PROGRAM ON DA [HYPERNET DESKTOP | hypernetOS] LETS YOU FOLLOW IT FROM AFAR.

A PARTY MEMBER CAN [TAKE A SEAT] FOR A POWER DAT ALREADY THINKS WELL OF DEM. DA SEAT EARNS DEM STANDIN' AN' A WEEKLY [STIPEND] DAT GROWS WIT IT. A CHARACTER CAN JOIN ONLY [ONCE], RESIGNIN' COSTS FAR MORE DEN JOININ' GAVE, AN' FALLIN' TOO FAR OUT OF FAVOUR GETS DEM DISMISSED.

ONCE A WEEK YOU CAN ATTEND A SESSION. DELEGATIONS SPEAK ON EACH MOTION, DEN YOU ANSWER:
- [SUPPORT] OR [OPPOSE]: YA SEAT VOTES DAT WAY
- [AMEND]: A SOFTER PUSH IN FAVOUR
- [FILIBUSTER]: TALK IT OUT WITOUT TAKIN' A SIDE
- [WILD]: A GAMBLE DAT MAY SWING DA ROOM EITHER WAY

A [PSI ROLL | partyDiceChecks] DECIDES HOW MUCH YA WORDS SWAY DA ROOM. FRIENDLY DELEGATIONS LISTEN, HOSTILE ONES DO NO, AN' DA [DIPLOMACY | progressSpecializations] SPECIALIZATION HELPS. DEN EVERY SEAT VOTES, IN DA OPEN OR IN SECRET.

[GRAVE MOTIONS], SUCH AS WAR, [THEONUCLEAR DEVICES | theonuclearBombingNewYork] OR DA [GOBLIN QUESTION | goblinHorde], GO TA DA [SECURITY COUNCIL] OF DA STRONGEST POWERS, WHICH HAB DA FINAL SAY OVER DA FLOOR VOTE.

lawCrime.title: CRIME AN' BOUNTY
lawCrime.description:
EVERY CRIME ADDS TA YA [BOUNTY]. DA LAW DEPENDS ON WHERE YOU STAND, SEE [WHOSE LAW APPLIES | lawJurisdictions], AN' A BOUNTY NEVER CROSSES DA BORDER.

DA BIGGER YA BOUNTY, DA WORSE DA WORLD TREATS YOU. SHOPS CHARGE MORE, DEN [TICKET COUNTERS | travelTickets] AN' [JOB BOARDS | econWork] TURN YOU AWAY, AN' IN DA END ORDINARY SHOPS WILL NO SERVE YOU AT ALL.

EACH CRIME ALSO RAISES DA [HEAT]: HOW HARD DA POLICE IZ LOOKIN' FOR YOU RIGHT NOW. WHEN IT RUNS HIGH, OFFICERS GIVE CHASE. HEAT FADES WIT TIME, AN' FASTER IN DA DARK.

WHILE NOBODY IZ LOOKIN' FOR YOU, AN OFFICER DOES NO KNOW YA FACE. ONCE DA HEAT IZ ON, STEPPIN' INTO AN OFFICER'S SIGHT IZ ENOUGH. DEY NO CAN SEE THROUGH WALLS AN' SEE LESS AT NIGHT, SO YOU CAN SLIP PAST BEHIND DEM. STOPPIN' TA CHAT WIT ONE WHILE WANTED IZ ASKIN' FOR TROUBLE.

MOST CRIMES NEED A [WITNESS | lawWitnesses], AN' WITNESSED CRIMES MAKE DA TOWN LESS [SAFE | peopleSettlements].

YOU SETTLE YA RECORD THROUGH DA [POLICE PORTAL | lawPolice], OR WHEN YOU IZ [ARRESTED | lawArrest]!

lawPolice.title: DA POLICE PORTAL
lawPolice.description:
DA [N€POLICE | hypernetNeuroPolice] APPLICATION ON DA HYPERNET LETS YOU SETTLE YA [RECORD | lawCrime] BEFORE YOU IZ CAUGHT.

- [CASE FILE]: EVERY CHARGE WIT ITS FINE, PAID ONE AT A TIME OR ALL AT ONCE

- [CUSTODY]: TURN YOURSELF IN, OR ASK FOR A HEARIN' BEFORE [ERIS | eris]

BOTH CUSTODY FIDDLY BITS TAKE YOU AWAY FROM DA COMPUTER, TA DA [CELLS | lawPrison] OR DA [COURTROOM | lawTrial]!

lawTrial.title: DA TRIAL
lawTrial.description:
[ERIS | eris] JUDGES EVERY TRIAL. DA COURTROOM, GALLERY AN' CASE LAW CHANGE EACH TIME.

BEFORE DA HEARIN' YOU CHOOSE YA [COUNSEL]: HIRE AN ADVOCATE, LET A PARTY MEMBER SPEAK FOR YOU, OR STAND ALONE. DA BRIEF SHOWS EACH ONE'S SKILL, FEE AN' YA CHANCES. HER [MOOD] CAN CHANGE EVERYTINK, AN' IN SOME MOODS SHE THROWS COUNSEL OUT, WIT [NO] REFUND.

DEFENDIN' YOURSELF, OR LETTIN' A COMPANION DO IT, TEACHES DA [LAW] [SPECIALIZATION | progressSpecializations]. A HIRED PROFESSIONAL TEACHES YOU NUTTIN'.

DA HEARIN' RUNS FROM [PLEA] TA [CHOICES] TA [VERDICT]. INNOCENT CLEARS YA WHOLE [BOUNTY | lawCrime]. TIME SPENT WIT HER AWAY FROM DA COURT BUILDS A [BOND | lawEris] DAT SOFTENS HER, AN' A STRONG ONE MAY SEE DA CASE THROWN OUT BEFORE IT STARTS.

ONE PLEA IZ [CHALLENGE ERIS], AN' IT TURNS DA HEARIN' INTO A FIGHT. AT FIRST NOBODY CAN DIE, AN' SHE EVEN HEALS YOU. DEN SHE FIGHTS FOR REAL.
- WIN: YA BOUNTY NEVER GROWS AGAIN IN DAT WORLD, AN' DERE IZ NO MORE DATES WIT HER.
- FLEE: YOU SERVE [A MONTH] IN [PRISON | lawPrison].
- LOSE: DA GAME IZ OVER.

- A [FIXED TERM] IZ SERVED ON DA GAME CLOCK. PRESS [OK] IN DA CELL TA SLEEP OR WAIT IT OUT, AN' YA [BOUNTY | lawCrime] IZ CLEARED ON RELEASE

societyMail.title: DA POST

societyArmy.description:

econStocks.title: DA STOCK MARKET

econShopOwning.title: OWNIN' A SHOP
econShopOwning.description:
A SHOP YOU OWN BELONGS TA DA WORLD: EVERY SAVEGAME OF DAT WORLD FINDS IT AS DA LAST ONE LEFT IT. ITS BOOK HAB PAGES FOR STAFF, SHELVES, STOCK AN' DA WAREHOUSE.

DA [TILLBOOK] PROGRAM ON DA [HYPERNET | hypernetOS] LETS YOU CHECK ON YA SHOPS FROM ANYWHERE. PRICIN', STOCKIN' AN' HIRIN' IZ STILL DONE IN PERSON!

econWork.title: WORK
econWork.description:

DA [FORGE] BOARD LISTS EVERY WEAPON AN' ARMOUR FROM YA FIRST VISIT. YA [TRAININ' | progressTraining] DECIDES WHICH OF DEM YOU CAN ACTUALLY MAKE.
