worldVoxelWalk.description:
DA [3D WORLD] IZ DA SAME EUROPE AS DA WORLD MAP, BUILT IN CUBES. REACH IT ON FOOT WIT [LIMINAL WALK] IN DA WORLD MAP TRAVEL MENU, WHEN YOU IZ NO RIDIN' ANYTINK, OR BY STEPPIN' OUT OF A VEHICLE YOU [DRIVE IN 3D | vehicleDriving].

[WASD] WALKS, DA [MOUSE] LOOKS, [Shift] RUNS, [SPACE] JUMPS, [CTRL] OR [C] CROUCHES. IN DEEP WATER JUMP KICKS UP AN' CROUCH DIVES. IF DA LEADER KNOWS DA [FLY | worldFlying] SKILL, [DOUBLE TAP] JUMP TA TAKE OFF AN' AGAIN TA LAND.

DA [MIDDLE MOUSE BUTTON], OR [R3] ON A CONTROLLER, SWAPS FIRST AN' [THIRD PERSON].

[E] INTERACTS WIT WHAT IZ IN FRONT OF YOU: TALK TA A [SHOPKEEPER | econShops] OR A PASSER-BY, LOOT, OPEN A CHEST, [FISH | gamesFishing], [FELL | worldTerrain] OR ME, RIDE A LIFT, OR CLIMB INTO YA VEHICLE. SHOPKEEPERS STAND UNDER A BLUE ROOF. [CHESTS | worldTreasure] PAY OUT AS DEY DO ELSEWHERE, AN' BETTER UNDERGROUND.

[ESC] OPENS DA PARTY MENU, AN' ITS RETURN TA DA WORLD MAP ENTRY IZ HOW YOU LEAVE. [Shift] AN' [R] OPENS DA WAIT MENU, [Shift] AN' [H] DIS BOOK, [H] DA CONTROL LIST, [M] CYCLES DA MAP VIEWS.

TIME RUNS FAST OUT HERE, AN' DA 2D MAPS CATCH UP WHEN YOU LEAVE. KEEP AN EYE ON DA SKY AROUND MIDNIGHT: NOW AN' DEN SOMETINK DAT IZ NO A BIRD CROSSES IT.

WIT [VR HEADSET] TURNED ON IN DA EXPERIMENTAL TAB OF [FIDDLY BITS | optionsMenu], AN ENTER VR BUTTON APPEARS WHENEVER A HEADSET IZ CONNECTED!

worldVoxelDigging.title: DIGGIN' AN' BUILDIN' IN 3D
worldVoxelDigging.description:
IN DA [3D WORLD | worldVoxelWalk] DA GROUND IZ MADE OF CUBES, AN' YOU CAN TAKE IT APART. HOLD DA [LEFT MOUSE BUTTON] TA STRIKE DA CUBE UNDER DA CROSSHAIR WIT WHATEVER DA LEADER HOLDS. BARE HANDS WORK TOO, JUST SLOWER, AN' A GUN OR BOW DIGS FROM AFAR. DA DEEPEST ROCK NEVER GIVES.

BROKEN CUBES GO ONTO DA [BLOCK BAR] AT DA BOTTOM OF DA SCREEN, NO INTO YA BAGS. WHEN IT IZ FULL, BUILD SOMETINK BEFORE YOU DIG MORE.

HOLD A BLOCK AN' CLICK, OR PRESS [G], TA PLACE IT WHERE YOU AIM. BUILD TA BRIDGE A RAVINE OR CLIMB A CLIFF. ORE SEAMS IZ DIFFERENT: DEY DROP STRAIGHT INTO YA BAGS AS CRAFTIN' MATERIALS.

DA BAR HAB FOUR VIEWS, SWITCHED WIT [Shift] AN' [Tab], OR [L1]:

- [BLOCKS]: YA WEAPON AN' WHAT YOU DUG
- [ITEMS]: YA QUICK BAR FAVOURITES
- [SPELLS]: DA LEADER'S [BATTLE SKILLS | progressLoadout]. ATTACK SPELLS BLAST CRATERS, AN' ONE DAT HITS A CREATURE STARTS A [FIGHT | combatVoxel]
- [VEHICLES | vehiclesOverview]: CALL ONE OF YA TA STAND IN FRONT OF YOU

DA [WHEEL] OR [Q] STEPS THROUGH DA CELLS, [1] TA [9] PICK ONE.

WHAT YOU DIG STAYS DUG. UNDER DA TOWNS RUN OLD BRICK [SEWERS], SOME REACHED THROUGH IRON MANHOLE COVERS IN DA ROAD, AN' [CAVES] WIND BENEATH DA LAND. YOU NO CAN DIG OR BUILD DURIN' A FIGHT!

combatVoxel.title: FIGHTIN' IN DA 3D WORLD
combatVoxel.description:
IN DA [3D WORLD | worldVoxelWalk] DERE IZ NO BATTLE SCREEN. FIGHTS HAPPEN WHERE YOU STAND, IN [REAL TIME]. A CREATURE DAT COMES CLOSE AN' SEES YOU STARTS ONE, AN' SO DOES A BLOW OR SPELL DAT LANDS ON IT. HITTIN' AN ANIMAL WHILE [DRIVIN' | vehicleDriving] ONLY KNOCKS IT ASIDE.

YOU PLAY DA [LEADER]. YA COMPANIONS ACT ON DEY OWN, CHOOSIN' DEY OWN ATTACKS, HEALS AN' REVIVES.

- [LEFT CLICK], OR [R2], USES DA WEAPON
- [RIGHT CLICK], OR [R1], USES DA CELL PICKED ON DA [BAR | worldVoxelDigging]: A SPELL, AN ITEM OR A BLOCK
- [R] RELOADS A GUN, OTHERWISE RAISES A QUICK [GUARD]

DURIN' A FIGHT YOU NO CAN DIG, BUILD OR OPEN DA PARTY MENU.

IF DA LEADER FALLS, DA NEXT ONE STANDIN' [TAKES THE LEAD]. RUN FAR ENOUGH FROM EVERY CREATURE TA GET AWAY. ONE DAT FLEES REMEMBERS ITS WOUNDS.

A WIN PAYS LIKE ANY BATTLE, AN' DA BODIES STAY FOR YOU TA LOOT WIT [E]. IF DA WHOLE PARTY FALLS, DA 3D WORLD CLOSES AN' [DEATH, GRAVESTONES AN' PERMADEATH | partyDeath] TAKES OVER!

economyHologramCheck.title: DA HOLOGRAM CHECK
economyHologramCheck.description:
IN DA [DEEDS] MENU, A PLACE YOU OWN HAB A [CHECK] BUTTON: A [SHOP | econShopOwning], A HOME, A [WORKPLACE | economyWorkplaces], A [CLAIM | economyLandClaims] OR A [TOWN YOU FOUNDED | craftingTownFounding]. IT SENDS DA PARTY DERE AS A [HOLOGRAM], WITOUT REALLY TRAVELLIN'.

AS A HOLOGRAM YOU IZ SEE THROUGH AN' WALK THROUGH WALLS AN' PEOPLE. LOOK AROUND FREELY, BUT TAKIN' A DOOR, STAIRS OR DA MAP EDGE ENDS DA PROJECTION AN' PUTS YOU BACK WHERE YOU STOOD.

WHILE PROJECTED, DA MENU BUTTON ASKS WHETHER TA [END THE HOLOGRAM] INSTEAD!

worldScenery.title: TINKZ YOU CAN USE ON DA MAP
worldScenery.description:
OUT IN DA WORLD, MANY OBJECTS DO SOMETINK WHEN YOU FACE DEM AN' PRESS DA ACTION BUTTON. A FEW EXAMPLES:

- [FOUNTAIN] OR [HYDRANT]: DRINK, OR WASH UP FOR [HYGIENE | needsHygiene]
- [PENTAGRAM]: REFILLS EVERYONE'S MP
- [BED], [CAMPFIRE] OR [TENT]: OPEN DA [SLEEP MENU | needsRestWorth]
- [BENCH] OR [CHAIR]: SIT DOWN
- [STOVE]: DA [COOKIN' MENU | craftCooking]. [PIANO | gamesPiano]: PLAY. [GAS PUMP]: [REFUEL | vehicleFuel]
- [map] OR [GLOBE]: DA [WORLD MAP | worldMapPage]. [BUS STOP | travelOverview]: CATCH DA BUS

CRATES, SACKS AN' BINS HOLD GOODS OR RUBBISH, VASES BREAK OPEN, AN' A GLINT OF [GOLD] MIGHT BE A HOARD, OR JUST FOOL'S GOLD. BONES, BOOKS AN' WEAPONS LYING 'BOUT CAN BE PICKED UP.

SHELVES, STATUES, GRAFFITI AN' SIGNS ALL HAB SOMETINK TA SAY. TORCHES AN' LAMPS CAN BE SWITCHED ON AN' OFF.

WARNIN': BREAKIN' INTO A [GRAVE] OR COFFIN IZ A [CRIME | lawCrime]!

worldAtlas.title: DA WORLD ATLAS
worldAtlas.description:
DA [ATLAS] IZ A MAP OF DA WHOLE PLANET, OPENED FROM DA [WORLD MAP | worldMapPage] PAGE OF DA MENU. IT DOES NO MOVE YOU ANYWHERE.

SWITCH BETWEEN [POWERS], [REGIONS] AN' [CLIMATE] WIT [Q] / [W], [Tab] OR [L1] / [R1]. CLICK A NATION TA READ 'BOUT IT: WHO HOLDS IT, ITS WEATHER, ITS DANGERS AN' ITS PAST.

[Left] AN' [right] STEP BACK THROUGH DA YEARS, FASTER WIT [Shift] HELD. GO BACK FAR ENOUGH AN' YOU MAY SEE DA WORLD AS IT WAZ BEFORE DA [SQUISHING | squishing].

[Up] AN' [down] STEP THROUGH DA NATIONS. [DRAG] PANS AN' DA [WHEEL] ZOOMS!

combatHyper.title: DA HYPER: LIMIT BREAKS
combatHyper.description:
EVERY CLASS HAB ONE [HYPER], A LIMIT BREAK WIT ITS OWN NAME. IT BECOMES AVAILABLE WHEN A CHARACTER IZ BADLY HURT [DURING] A FIGHT. WHEN IT IZ READY, IT APPEARS IN DA COMMAND MENU IN PLACE OF [DEFENSE | combatCommands] OR [RELOAD | combatAmmo], AN' A NOTICE TELLS YOU.

IT PERFORMS ONE HUGE MOVE BASED ON DA CLASS: A SWEEP OVER EVERY FOE, A FULL HEAL, DA FALLEN RAISED, AN' MORE. FOR DAT TURN DA USER IZ UNTOUCHABLE.

EACH CHARACTER CAN USE IT [ONCE A DAY]. A [FREELANCER | partyClasses] BORROWS SOMEONE ELSE'S!

combatAmmo.title: AMMO AN' RELOADIN'
combatAmmo.description:
GUNS, BOWS AN' OTHER RANGED WEAPONS HOLD A [MAGAZINE]. DA ROUNDS LEFT SHOW ON DA [ATTACK | combatCommands] COMMAND.

EACH ATTACK SPENDS AMMO, AN' FAST WEAPONS FIRE A [BURST]. WHEN DA MAGAZINE IZ EMPTY, ATTACK BECOMES A [BASH] WIT DA WEAPON ITSELF.

[RELOAD] FILLS IT AN' RAISES YA GUARD, BUT USES YA TURN. DA MAGAZINE IZ [NOT] REFILLED BETWEEN FIGHTS, SO RELOAD BEFORE DA NEXT ONE.

SOME WEAPONS HAB A [SPECIAL SKILL]. WHEN YOU CAN AFFORD IT, IT TAKES DA RELOAD ROW AN' RELOADS AS IT FIRES!

gearMartialArts.title: MARTIAL ARTS AN' WEAPON SCHOOLS
gearMartialArts.description:
[FISTS], [CLAWS] AN' [NUNCHAKUS] IZ MARTIAL WEAPONS. DEY FILL BOTH HANDS, BUT YOU STILL FIGHT WIT YA BODY THROUGH DEM.

[MARTIAL ARTS] SKILLS NEED YA HANDS FREE, THOUGH MARTIAL WEAPONS DO NO COUNT AGAINST DAT. BODIES WIT MORE OR FEWER HANDS HAB DEY OWN WAY OF FIGHTIN'.

DA [GUN-FU | partyTraits] TRAIT LETS YOU USE MARTIAL ARTS WIT A BOW, SLING OR GUN IN HAND, WIT A [FREE SHOT] AFTER EACH ONE.

[SWORDSMANSHIP] SKILLS NEED A MELEE WEAPON, AN' [FIREARMS] SKILLS A RANGED ONE. A SKILL YOU NO CAN USE RIGHT NOW IZ GREYED OUT!

elementInfusions.title: INFUSION SPELLS
elementInfusions.description:
DA THREE [INFUSION] SPELLS CHARGE DA [WHOLE PARTY] WIT AN ELEMENT.

- [FlameInfusion]: GRANTS [HOT | hot] AN' RAISES STR
- [FrostInfusion]: GRANTS [COLD | cold] AN' RAISES CON
- [ThunderInfusion]: GRANTS [STATIC | static] AN' RAISES DEX

DA STATE ALWAYS LANDS, AN' YA ATTACKS CARRY DAT ELEMENT WHILE IT LASTS. INFUSIONS ACT [LAST] IN DA ROUND!

needsGrooming.title: TOILETRIES AN' COSMETICS
needsGrooming.description:
[TOILETRIES] RESTORE [HYGIENE | needsHygiene] WHEN USED FROM DA BACKPACK: SOAP, SHAMPOO, A TOOTHBRUSH, DEODORANT AN' MORE. A RELAXIN' BATH KIT EVEN ADDS A LIL' FUN.

[COSMETICS] MAKE YOU LOOK SHARPER FOR A WHILE, RAISIN' YA [SUBSTANCE] LOOK: LIPSTICK, PERFUME, HAIR GEL, HAIR DYE AN' DA LIKE. DIFFERENT ONES STACK, AN' USING DA SAME ONE AGAIN JUST REFRESHES IT!

partyMetamorphosis.title: CHANGIN' YA LOOKS
partyMetamorphosis.description:
A CHARACTER CAN CHANGE DEY BODY AN' FACE AFTER CREATION.

- [METAMORPHOSIS POTION]: OPENS EVERY BODY AN' DEN DA FACE GALLERY. USE IT ON ONE PARTY MEMBER FROM DA [BACKPACK | gearBackpack]. IT COSTS 'BOUT [250 EUROS] AN' CAN BE CRAFTED
- [SURGERYBOT SWARM]: DA SAME, BUT ONLY WIT BODIES SEEN IN DIS WORLD. 'BOUT [200 EUROS]
- AT A [CLINIC | healthSurgery]: [PLASTIC SURGERY] CHANGES DA BODY FOR [100 EUROS], [FACE SURGERY] DA PORTRAIT FOR [50 EUROS]

IF YOU LEAVE WITOUT CHANGIN' ANYTINK, DA POTION OR SWARM IZ GIVEN BACK!

partyFamiliar.title: FAMILIARS
partyFamiliar.description:
A [FAMILIAR] IZ A CREATURE BOUND TA ONE CHARACTER FOR GOOD. IT BELONGS TA WHOEVER CALLED IT, NO TA DA PARTY.

CAST [ConvokeFamiliar] TA CALL YA. YA [CLASS | partyClasses] DECIDES WHAT ANSWERS: A NECROMANCER MEETS SOMETINK DEAD, A MECHANIC SOMETINK BUILT, A WITCH A BAT OR A GHOST. DA SAME CHARACTER ALWAYS MEETS DA SAME FAMILIAR, AN' IT GROWS WIT ITS OWNER'S [LEVEL | progressLevels].

ONCE CALLED, IT [STAYS]. IT WALKS WIT YOU AN' JOINS [EVERY BATTLE] AS DA FOURTH MEMBER. SOME CAN BE [RIDDEN | partyRiding]: TALK TA IT AN' PICK RIDE.

IT LEAVES IF IT IZ [KILLED], IF YOU [DEMATERIALIZE] IT, OR IF ITS OWNER LEAVES DA PARTY. YOU CAN CALL IT BACK FROM DA SKILL OR DA [PETS | partyPets] PAGE, BUT NO DURIN' A BATTLE!

powersOwnParty.title: FOUNDIN' A POLITICAL PARTY
powersOwnParty.description:
YA PARTY CAN FOUND [ONE POLITICAL PARTY] OF ITS OWN IN EACH WORLD.

HOW TA DO IT:

1. OPEN [POLITICS | peoplePolitics] FROM DA MAIN MENU AN' GO TA DA [OWN PARTY] TAB. DA [PROPAGANDA2] PROGRAM ON DA [HYPERNET DESKTOP | hypernetOS] WORKS TOO.
2. GIVE IT A NAME, OR ROLL ONE. IF YOU RAISED A [FACTION | peopleFactions], ITS NAME IZ SUGGESTED.
3. CHOOSE AN [IDEOLOGY]. DIS IZ DA ONLY TINK YOU MUST PICK.
4. PICK UP TA [3 TENETS], SUCH AS LIBERTY, ORDER OR ARCANA. OPPOSITE TENETS NO CAN BE HELD TOGETHER.
5. SET DA [WEEKLY FEE] EACH SUPPORTER PAYS, FROM 1 EURO TA 10000 EUROS.
6. CONFIRM. EVERYONE IN YA PARTY JOINS AS A FOUNDIN' MEMBER.

A NEW PARTY HAB [NO SUPPORTERS]. WIN DEM WIT [CAMPAIGNS | powersCampaigns], OR ONE BY ONE IN DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL.

EVERY WEEK EACH SUPPORTER PAYS DA FEE TA YOU. DA FEE ALSO DECIDES [WHO JOINS]: A CHEAP ONE DRAWS DA POOR, A STEEP ONE ONLY DA WEALTHY. SOME SUPPORTERS DRIFT AWAY OVER TIME WHATEVER YOU DO.

YOU CAN CHANGE DA NAME, IDEOLOGY, TENETS AN' FEE AT ANY TIME, AN' WIT DEM WHO DA PARTY APPEALS TA!

powersCampaigns.title: POLITICAL CAMPAIGNS
powersCampaigns.description:
A [CAMPAIGN] SPENDS MONEY OVER DAYS OR MONTHS TA WIN PEOPLE TA A PARTY: YA, OR ANY OTHER. RUN ONE FROM DA [CAMPAIGNS] PAGE OF [PROPAGANDA2 | powersOwnParty].

1. CHOOSE DA KIND. A [CONVERSION] WINS PEOPLE OVER. A [SMEAR] SHAKES DA FAITH OF A RIVAL PARTY'S SUPPORTERS. YA OWN PARTY NO CAN BE SMEARED.
2. CHOOSE DA PARTY, AN' WHERE: DA WHOLE WORLD, A TOWN, A NATION OR A [HYPERPOWER | peoplePolitics].
3. CHOOSE HOW HARD: LEAFLETS AT 20 EUROS A DAY, RALLIES AT 100, BROADCASTS AT 500, SATURATION AT 2500.
4. CHOOSE HOW LONG, FROM 1 DAY TA 6 MONTHS.
5. READ DA [PROJECTION], DEN LAUNCH. DA WHOLE COST IZ PAID UP FRONT.

CROWDED PLACES COST MORE TA REACH. PEOPLE WHO ALREADY LEAN YA WAY IZ EASY TA WIN, DA DEEPLY COMMITTED IZ HARD. A SMEAR SOFTENS DA GROUND FOR YA NEXT CONVERSION!

powersElections.title: RUNNIN' FOR OFFICE
powersElections.description:
ANY MEMBER OF YA PARTY CAN STAND IN AN UPCOMIN' ELECTION: A TOWN'S [MAYOR | peoplePolitics], A NATION'S GOVERNMENT, OR A HYPERPOWER'S HEAD OF STATE. DO IT FROM DA [ELECTIONS] PAGE OF [PROPAGANDA2 | powersOwnParty].

1. PICK DA CANDIDATE.
2. PICK DA ELECTION FROM DA LIST.
3. PRESS STAND AN' PAY DA [DEPOSIT]: 100 EUROS FOR A TOWN, 2000 FOR A NATION, 20000 FOR A HYPERPOWER. IT IZ NEVER RETURNED, WIN OR LOSE.

EACH MEMBER STANDS IN ONE ELECTION AT A TIME, AN' CAN WITHDRAW BEFORE DA VOTE. DA [HOLY VATICAN EMPIRE | vaticanEmpire] PICKS ITS HEAD IN A CONCLAVE AN' TAKES NO OUTSIDERS.

WIT A [POLITICAL PARTY | powersOwnParty] BEHIND DEM, YA CANDIDATE GETS ITS PLATFORM AN' ITS VOTERS. WITOUT ONE, DEY RUN ALONE AS AN INDEPENDENT. VOTERS LEAN TOWARD WHOEVER THINKS LIKE DEM.

WIN A TOWN AN' YOU APPOINT ITS GUARD CAPTAIN, TAX COLLECTOR AN' HIGH PRIEST. WIN A NATION AN' YOU LEAD IT, UNLESS HISTORY ALREADY HOLDS DAT SEAT. IN DA LAST DAYS BEFORE A VOTE, [ENDORSE A CANDIDATE] IN DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL TA SWAY VOTERS ONE BY ONE!

peopleCivics.title: TALKIN' BELIEFS AN' POLITICS
peopleCivics.description:
DA [BELIEFS] AN' [POLITICS] GROUPS OF DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL LET YOU WORK ON WHAT SOMEONE BELIEVES AN' HOW DEY VOTE.

[BELIEFS]: PREACH YA CREED, DEBATE DEY, ASK DEY VIEWS, OR PRAY TOGETHER IF YOU BOTH HOLD A FAITH.

[POLITICS]:

- [ASK ABOUT THEIR VOTE]. DA WARY KEEP IT TA THEMSELVES UNLESS DEY TRUST YOU.
- [JOIN THEIR PARTY], OR [INVITE TA YA PARTY | powersOwnParty].
- [CAMPAIGN FOR A PARTY]: NUDGE DEY VIEWS. CHARM AN' DA PUBLIC SPEAKIN' [SPECIALIZATION | progressSpecializations] HELP.
- [ENDORSE A CANDIDATE | powersElections]: ONLY CLOSE TA AN ELECTION.
- [PETITION]: ONLY FOR SOMEONE WHO HOLDS AN OFFICE.

A REFUSAL COOLS DEM A LIL'. PESTERIN' DA UNINTERESTED COOLS DEM MORE.

[PETITIONING] DA POWERFUL CAN BUY A [PARDON | lawCrime] FOR YA HEAVIEST CHARGE, FOR HALF ITS BOUNTY, OR A TAX CUT FOR DEY COUNTRY, FOR 5000 EUROS. YOU PAY ONLY IF DEY AGREE, AN' DA BETTER DEY LIKE YOU, DA LIKELIER DAT IZ!

peopleDeals.title: MONEY, WORK AN' FAVOURS
peopleDeals.description:
DA [MONEY] AN' [WORK AND TRAVEL] GROUPS OF DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL IZ DEALS WIT GROWN, THINKIN' PEOPLE. MOST CAN BE TRIED ONCE A DAY PER PERSON.

[MONEY]:

- [ASK FOR STOCK TIPS] FROM SOMEONE WHO OWNS [SHARES | econStocks]. NO EVERYONE TELLS DA TRUTH.
- [TRADE SHARES]: MATES GIVE FAIRER PRICES.
- [LEND MONEY]: 20, 50, 100 OR 250 EUROS, OWED BACK WIT INTEREST IN A WEEK. DA HONEST USUALLY REPAY.
- [BORROW MONEY]: ONLY FROM A RICH MATE. IT IZ TAKEN BACK WHEN DUE. FAIL TA PAY AN' DA FRIENDSHIP SOURS FAST.

[WORK AND TRAVEL]:

- [ASK FOR WORK | econWork] AT DEY WORKPLACE.
- [HIRE] AN' [FIRE] FOR A [SHOP YOU OWN | econShopOwning] IN DEY TOWN. FIRIN' SOMEONE IZ NO FORGOTTEN.
- [WORK TOGETHER]: A FEW HOURS BESIDE DEM, FOR A SHARE OF DA PAY.
- [ASK FOR A RIDE], FOR A FARE, OR FREE FROM A GOOD MATE.
- [BORROW THEIR VEHICLE] FOR A DAY. LOSE IT AN' DEY REPORT IT [STOLEN | lawCrime].
- [INVITE TO MOVE] TA ANOTHER TOWN, OR [INVITE TO AN EXPEDITION] ON A [TOWER FLOOR | worldDungeon]!

peopleHelping.title: HELPIN', GAMES AN' MATCHMAKIN'
peopleHelping.description:
DA [HELP], [GAMES], [ROMANCE] AN' [TALK] GROUPS OF DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL HOLD DA KINDER ACTIONS.

[HELP]:

- [TREAT THEM] WIT A HEALIN' ITEM FROM YA PACK.
- [GIVE MEDICINE | healthDiseases] FOR AN ILLNESS DEY SHOW.
- [FIRST AID]: SOMEONE [DOWNED | lawDowned] GETS BACK ON DEY FEET, AN' IZ GRATEFUL.
- [OFFER A FIX | needsAddiction] TA AN ADDICT. DEY WILL LOVE YOU FOR IT, AN' DA HABIT DEEPENS.
- [INTERVENE]: TALK AN ADDICT TOWARD QUITTIN'.
- [OFFER SHELTER]: A [REFUGEE | peopleHorde] OR SOMEONE SLEEPIN' ROUGH MOVES INTO A HOUSE YOU OWN.

[GAMES]: [CHALLENGE TA A GAME | gamesOverview] DEY KNOW, FOR FUN OR FOR 5, 20 OR 50 EUROS.

[ROMANCE]: [INTRODUCE TO SOMEONE] MATCHES TWO SINGLE PEOPLE YOU BOTH KNOW. MAYBE DEY HIT IT OFF.

[TALK]: [RUMOURS AN' NEWS | societyNews] TELLS YOU WHAT DA WORLD IZ TALKIN' 'BOUT, FROM WARS TA DA [HORDE | goblinHorde]!

partyRiding.title: RIDIN' A COMPANION
partyRiding.description:
A PET, A FOLLOWER OR A [FAMILIAR | partyFamiliar] CAN CARRY YOU. PARTY MEMBERS AN' CHILDREN NEVER CAN.

1. OPEN DA [PETS | partyPets] PAGE AN' SWITCH DA COMPANION TA [RIDABLE].
2. PRESS [RIDE] ON ITS ROW, OR PRESS OK FACIN' IT AN' CHOOSE RIDE.
3. TA GET OFF, PRESS OK ON AN EMPTY TILE AN' CHOOSE STOP RIDIN', OR PRESS [DISMOUNT] ON DA PETS PAGE.

A FAMILIAR MUST BE CONVOKED TA BE RIDDEN.

IN DA SADDLE YOU TRAVEL FASTER DEN ON FOOT, ROADS ON DA WORLD MAP GO BY QUICKER, AN' YOU CAN STILL TALK, OPEN DOORS AN' USE WHAT IZ AROUND YOU. YOU GET OFF AT DA CAMPER DOOR. RIDIN' TRAINS [HORSE RIDIN' | progressSpecializations] AN' ANIMAL TRAININ'.

OTHER RIDABLE COMPANIONS CARRY DA REST OF DA PARTY. RIDIN' BELONGS TA DA ORDINARY MAPS AN' DA WORLD MAP, NO DA [3D WORLD | worldVoxelWalk]!

lawDowned.title: DOWNED PEOPLE AN' BODIES
lawDowned.description:
A FIGHT BETWEEN PEOPLE DAT ENDS WIT BLUNT BLOWS LEAVES DA LOSER [DOWNED]: ON DA GROUND, CRAWLIN'. GIVEN TIME, DEY GET UP ON DEY OWN.

PRESS OK ON A BODY TA SEE WHAT YOU CAN DO:

- A DOWNED [PERSON]: LOOT, FIRST AID, COUP DE GRACE
- A DOWNED [MONSTER]: COUP DE GRACE
- A [CORPSE]: LOOT, BUTCHER

TAKIN' ANYTINK FROM SOMEONE STILL BREATHIN' IZ A [ROBBERY | lawCrime]. DEY [CAR KEYS | roadTraffic] OPEN DEY PARKED CAR.

[FIRST AID] GETS DEM UP AT ONCE. NO CRIME, AN' DEY WILL REMEMBER DA KINDNESS.

A [COUP DE GRACE] ON A PERSON IZ [MURDER] IF ANYONE SEES IT, UNLESS DEY WAZ [WANTED]: DEN YOU COLLECT DA BOUNTY INSTEAD.

[BUTCHER] HARVESTS WHAT DA BODY HAB TA GIVE.

DA HURT HEAL IN TIME, FASTER AT A [CLINIC | healthSurgery]!

lawStreet.title: STREET CRIME, WANTED PEOPLE AN' PATROLS
lawStreet.description:
TOWNS HAB CRIMES OF DEY OWN. PICKPOCKETS WORK DA CROWDS, VICTIMS FIGHT BACK, OLD GRUDGES TURN INTO BRAWLS, AN' YOU HEAR 'BOUT IT AS IT HAPPENS. PICKPOCKETS STEER CLEAR OF ANYONE WHO LOOKS [INTIMIDATING].

EVERY CRIME PUTS A [BOUNTY] ON WHOEVER DID IT. A [WANTED] PERSON, OR ONE WIT A WARRANT ON DA [QUEST BOARD | econQuests], CAN BE FOUGHT WITOUT IT BEING A CRIME, AN' WHOEVER BRINGS DEM DOWN COLLECTS.

WHEN MONSTERS WANDER INTO TOWN, GUARDS AN' DA BRAVE STAND AN' FIGHT. EVERYONE ELSE RUNS.

[PATROLS]: DA HOTTER YA [HEAT | lawCrime], DA MORE OFFICERS WALK DA STREETS. DEY DRIFT HOME AS IT FADES.

WHERE DA [GOBLIN HORDE | peopleHorde] HAB RULED FOR A WHILE, DA STREETS IZ ROUGHER!

peopleZombies.title: DA ZOMBIE WORLD
peopleZombies.description:
IN A WORLD MADE WIT DA [ZOMBIE | setupTimelines] POPULATION, MOST PEOPLE IZ WALKIN' DEAD. DEY SHUFFLE THROUGH DA ROUTINES DEY HAB IN LIFE, BUT DERE IZ NUTTIN' LEFT TA SAY: [TOUCHIN' ONE STARTS A FIGHT | combatBasics].

DA DEAD IZ DA SAME ON EVERY VISIT, AN' A ZOMBIE YOU [KILL STAYS DEAD]. FLEE INSTEAD AN' IT IZ DAZED FOR A MOMENT.

LEARN TA TELL DEM APART:

- [SHAMBLERS] IZ SLOW AN' SHORT SIGHTED
- [RUNNERS] SEE FAR AN' CHASE FASTER DEN YOU WALK
- [SCREAMERS] WAKE EVERY ZOMBIE NEARBY

AN' WORSE TINKZ CRAWL AN' LURK. WALLS HIDE YOU FROM MOST OF DEM, NO ALL. A ZOMBIE DAT LOSES YOU GOES TA WHERE IT LAST SAW YOU, DEN GIVES UP!

peopleHorde.title: DA HORDE'S GROUND AN' REFUGEES
peopleHorde.description:
IN A NATION RULED BY DA [GOBLIN HORDE | goblinHorde], DA TOWNS IZ FULL OF [GOBLINS]: ORDINARY CITIZENS WIT NAMES, JOBS AN' HOMES, NO BAD 'UNS.

DA LONGER DA HORDE HOLDS A COUNTRY, DA ROUGHER IT GETS: MORE [PICKPOCKETS | lawStreet], MORE BRAWLS, FEWER POLICE, LITTER IN DA STREETS.

WHEN DA HORDE [CONQUERS] A COUNTRY, DOZE WHO WILL NO LIVE GOBLIN LIVES PACK UP AN' LEAVE, FOR A FREE COUNTRY NEARBY OR A [CAMP OF TENTS] BY DA BORDER. WHEN DA HORDE [LOSES] ONE, DA REFUGEES SLOWLY COME HOME.

GIVE A REFUGEE A ROOF WIT [OFFER SHELTER | peopleHelping] IN DA [EMPATHIZE PANEL | peopleEmpathize]!

progressSpellCrafting.title: MAKIN' NEW SPELLS AN' SKILLS
progressSpellCrafting.description:
ALL OF DIS HAPPENS IN DA [TRAININ' | progressTraining] MENU. OPEN A MEMBER'S SCHOOLS: DA BENCHES IZ ON DA RIGHT PAGE, AN' EACH ONE SPENDS DA PARTY'S [KP | progressKnowledge].

WAYS TA MAKE SOMETINK NEW:

- [FUSE SPELLS | progressFusion]: MELT TWO ABILITIES INTO ONE, IF DA DICE ALLOW
- [CRAFT SPELL AN' CRAFT SKILL | progressWorkbench]: BUILD YA OWN FROM PARTS
- [ENCHANT WEAPON, EQUIPMENT OR BOOK | progressEnchanting]: BIND A SPELL INTO GEAR
- [WRITE SKILL BOOK AN' WRITE GRIMORIE | progressWritingBooks]: PUT WHAT YOU KNOW INTO A BOOK, TA TEACH IT TA OTHERS

[HEXORCIZE | progressHexorcize] WORKS DA OTHER WAY, BREAKIN' MAGICAL GEAR BACK DOWN INTO KP.

YOU CAN ALSO LEARN EXISTIN' ABILITIES ON A [SCHOOL TREE | progressAtlas], FROM [GRIMOIRES AN' SKILL BOOKS | progressGrimoires], FROM PEOPLE IN DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL, FROM SOME SHOPS, OR AT DA END OF AN [ADVENTURE | worldAdventures]. IN A [WORLD OF CHAOS | setupTimelines], SKILLS COME ON DEY OWN AS YOU LEVEL.

A SPELL MADE ON A BENCH BELONGS TA ITS MAKER. WRITE IT INTO A BOOK TA SHARE IT!

progressWorkbench.title: WRITIN' YA OWN SPELLS
progressWorkbench.description:
[CRAFT SPELL] AN' [CRAFT SKILL], ON DA RIGHT PAGE OF [TRAININ' | progressTraining], BUILD A NEW ABILITY FROM PARTS. A SPELL SPENDS MP, A SKILL SPENDS AP.

1. PICK A [CORE]: AN [ELEMENT | elementsOverview] LIKE FIRE OR ICE, HEALIN', A HARD BLOW, AN AIMED SHOT, AN' MORE.
2. PICK AN [AMPLIFIER] FOR MORE POWER.
3. PICK A [SHAPE]: ONE BAD 'UN, ALL OF DEM, AN ALLY, YOURSELF.
4. ADD [RIDERS] SUCH AS POISON OR A SHIELD, AN' [REFINEMENTS] SUCH AS NEVER MISSIN' OR CASTIN' TWICE.
5. GIVE IT A NAME, A DESCRIPTION, AN ICON AN' AN ANIMATION.
6. PRESS WRITE.

[ROLL IT] FILLS EVERY ROW AT RANDOM, IF YOU WANT A SURPRISE.

EVERY PART COSTS [KP | progressKnowledge] AN' MAKES DA ABILITY MORE DEMANDIN': HARDER TA CAST, AN' NEEDIN' A STRONGER [STAT | partyAttributes] FROM WHOEVER USES IT.

NAME A SPELL IN ONE [CamelCase | camelcaseMagic] WORD, LIKE FireBolt.

YOU CAN REBUILD AN ABILITY LATER, PAYIN' ONLY DA DIFFERENCE. [UNMAKE] DELETES IT FOR NUTTIN' BACK!

progressEnchanting.title: ENCHANTIN' GEAR
progressEnchanting.description:
THREE BENCHES IN [TRAININ' | progressTraining] BIND A SPELL INTO A PIECE OF GEAR. ONLY SPELLS CAN BE BOUND, NEVER SKILLS, AN' DA CASTER KEEPS KNOWIN' IT.

1. OPEN DA BENCH.
2. PICK A PIECE YOU CARRY OR WEAR.
3. PICK A SPELL AN' CONFIRM.

DA OLD PIECE IZ GONE, AN' A UNIQUE NEW ONE TAKES ITS PLACE.

- [ENCHANT WEAPON]: AN ATTACK SPELL BURSTS OUT ON EVERY CRITICAL HIT
- [ENCHANT EQUIPMENT]: A PROTECTIVE SPELL TRIGGERS WHEN DA WEARER IZ STRUCK HARD
- [ENCHANT BOOK]: ANY SPELL, CAST FOR FREE WHENEVER DA BOOK IZ READ

BEWARE: AN ENCHANTED BOOK MAY [BURN] AS IT IZ READ. A SKILLED [ENCHANTIN' | progressSpecializations] READER KEEPS IT LONGER.

IT COSTS [KP | progressKnowledge], MORE FOR STRONGER AN' STRANGER SPELLS. A PIECE DAT ALREADY HOLDS A SPELL NO CAN TAKE ANOTHER. [UNMAKE] DESTROYS AN ENCHANTED PIECE FOR NUTTIN' BACK!

progressWritingBooks.title: WRITIN' SKILL BOOKS AN' GRIMORIES
progressWritingBooks.description:
[WRITE SKILL BOOK] AN' [WRITE GRIMORIE], IN [TRAININ' | progressTraining], COPY WHAT DA PARTY KNOWS INTO A BOOK. A SKILL BOOK HOLDS SKILLS, A GRIMORIE HOLDS SPELLS.

1. OPEN DA BENCH AN' CHOOSE A FEW PAGES FROM EVERYTINK YA MEMBERS KNOW.
2. CHECK DA PRICE IN [KP | progressKnowledge].
3. PRESS WRITE. DA BOOK GOES INTO YA BACKPACK.

USE IT FROM DA BACKPACK. IT OPENS LIKE A [GRIMOIRE | progressGrimoires], OFFERIN' EXACTLY YA PAGES. HAND EACH PAGE TA A MEMBER WHO DOES NO KNOW IT YET.

DA BOOK IZ USED UP ONCE EVERY PAGE HAB BIN TAKEN. CLOSE IT EARLY AN' NUTTIN' IZ LOST: IT RETURNS TA YA PACK, AN' DA PAGES TAKEN IN DAT SITTIN' IZ FORGOTTEN AGAIN.

DIS IZ HOW A SPELL [MADE ON A BENCH | progressWorkbench] REACHES DA REST OF DA PARTY!

progressHexorcize.title: HEXORCIZIN'
progressHexorcize.description:
[HEXORCIZE], DA LAST BENCH IN [TRAININ' | progressTraining], BREAKS MAGICAL WEAPONS AN' EQUIPMENT DOWN INTO [KP | progressKnowledge].

ONLY MAGICAL PIECES IN YA PACK IZ LISTED, SO TAKE A PIECE OFF FIRST. RICHER, STRONGER AN' [ENCHANTED | progressEnchanting] PIECES GIVE MORE.

PICK A PIECE AN' CHOOSE [UNMAKE] FOR ONE COPY OR [UNMAKE ALL] FOR EVERY COPY. IT NO CAN BE UNDONE!

hypernetHyperdeck.title: DA HYPERDECK
hypernetHyperdeck.description:
DA [HYPERDECK] IZ A FOLDIN' HANDHELD COMPUTER DA PARTY BUILDS. OPEN IT WIT [P] OR FROM DA HYPERNET TILE OF DA MAIN MENU.

CLICK DA SCREEN TA SWITCH IT ON. CLICK DA BASE TA OPEN DA BOARD, DEN DRAG [COMPONENTS] ONTO DA GRID. COMPONENTS IZ ITEMS YOU BUY, FIND OR SALVAGE, AN' FITTIN' ONE TAKES IT FROM YA [BACKPACK | gearBackpack].

- L1 AN' R1 OR TAB TURN A PART
- [AUTO FIT] FILLS DA BOARD FROM WHAT YOU CARRY
- [CASE] PICKS A DIFFERENT SHELL, EMPTYIN' DA BOARD BACK INTO YA BAG
- [BIOS] LISTS WHAT IZ WRONG

TA BOOT, DA DECK NEEDS A [PROCESSOR], [MEMORY], [STORAGE], A [PANEL] AN' A [CELL] STRONG ENOUGH TA POWER IT ALL. HOT MACHINES WANT COOLIN'.

ONCE IT BOOTS YOU REACH DA [HYPERNET DESKTOP | hypernetOS], AN' YA PARTS SHOW UP IN DA [CONTROL PANEL | hypernetControlPanel]. EVERY PARTY STARTS WIT A CHEAP SECOND HAND DECK DAT JUST 'BOUT WORKS.

DA [CHIP] BUTTON OPENS DA [CHIP LAB | hypernetChipLab], WHERE YOU CAN ETCH A PROCESSOR OF YA OWN!

hypernetChipLab.title: DA CHIP LAB
hypernetChipLab.description:
DA [CHIP LAB] IZ A BENCH WHERE YOU DRAW YA OWN LOGIC AN' ETCH IT ONTO A PROCESSOR FOR DA [HYPERDECK | hypernetHyperdeck]. OPEN IT WIT DA CHIP BUTTON ON DA DECK, OR WIT DA CIRCUIT BOARD EDITOR ON DA [DESKTOP | hypernetOS].

YOU DRAW ON A GRID WIT WIRES, TORCHES DAT INVERT A SIGNAL, REPEATERS, BRIDGES, GATES, CLOCKS AN' LAMPS.

- LEFT BUTTON DRAWS, RIGHT BUTTON RUBS OUT
- PICK A TILE TWICE TA CHANGE ITS FIDDLY BITS
- RUN, PAUSE AN' STEP TEST DA CIRCUIT
- READY MADE CIRCUITS CAN BE STAMPED IN

[ETCH DIE] TURNS DA DRAWIN' INTO A PROCESSOR PART, PAID FOR IN [SALVAGED STEEL]. MORE LOGIC MAKES A FASTER CHIP, AN' A HUNGRIER ONE.

UNFINISHED CIRCUITS STAY STASHED ON DA BENCH!

hypernetCalendar.title: APP: CALENDAR
hypernetCalendar.description:
A MONTH TA A PAGE CALENDAR ON DA [HYPERNET DESKTOP | hypernetOS]. IT WORKS WITOUT A LINE.

EACH DAY SHOWS DA [PUBLIC HOLIDAYS | peopleHolidays] OF DA NATION YOU PICK, DA COMIN' [ELECTIONS | powersElections] AN' DA DEADLINES OF YA [QUESTS | econQuests].

ADD YA OWN [APPOINTMENTS] WIT AN HOUR AN' A NOTE, AN' YOU WILL BE REMINDED ON DA DAY!

minigamesCardTables.title: CARD GAMES AGAINST PEOPLE
minigamesCardTables.description:
DA [CARD GAME | gamesCards] CAN BE PLAYED FOR REAL.

IN DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL, CHALLENGE SOMEONE TA A [CARD DUEL] OR OFFER TA [SWAP CARDS], ONCE A DAY EACH. SOMEONE WHO DISLIKES YOU REFUSES.

BEFORE A DUEL, CHOOSE DA STAKE: NUTTIN', SOME MONEY, OR AN ITEM OF YA AGAINST ONE OF DEY. WALKIN' OUT OF A STAKED DUEL [FORFEITS] IT. YOU NEED A DECK OF AT LEAST 9 CARDS TA SIT DOWN.

[HYPER CARD ARENA], ON DA [HYPERNET DESKTOP | hypernetOS], PITS YOU AGAINST DA MACHINE. PLAY A SINGLE MATCH, OR PAY AN ENTRY FEE OF 10 TA 300 EUROS FOR A KNOCK OUT BRACKET OF EIGHT. EACH WIN PAYS YOU BACK AN' MORE, AN' DA TITLE BRINGS A PRIZE. LOSE ONCE AN' DA RUN IZ OVER!

galaxyRocketLaunch.title: COILGUN LAUNCHES
galaxyRocketLaunch.description:
FROM A [SPACEPORT], A COILGUN THROWS AN ARMOURED ROUND INTO DA SKY. PICK WHERE YOU LEAVE FROM, DA FLIGHT AN' WHERE YOU COME DOWN.

YOU CAN LEAVE FROM [APULIA | topicApuliaSpaceCenter], [GREENWICH | topicGreenwitchSpaceCenter], DA OMEGA TOWER, YA [STARSHIP | vehicleStarship] IN ORBIT, OR A PATRON'S [VAULT | galaxyPatrons].

FARES:

- A HOP BETWEEN GREENWICH AN' APULIA: FREE
- DOWN FROM ORBIT: 200 EUROS
- UP TA DA STARSHIP: 500 EUROS
- DA MOON BASE: 1,200 EUROS
- FARTHER WONDERS: 2,000 TA 3,000 EUROS

YOU PAY ONLY WHEN DA FLIGHT STARTS. FLIGHTS TA A VAULT AN' IN DA STORY IZ FREE.

ON DA WAY UP DA ROUND CROSSES A BELT OF [ORBITAL DEBRIS | kesslerSyndrome], WORSE IN STORMS AN' AT NIGHT. DA AUTOPILOT ALWAYS GETS YOU THROUGH.

PRESS [F], OR HOLD DA PAD'S TOP BUTTON, TA FLY [BY HAND] AN' STEER THROUGH DA DEBRIS YOURSELF. WARNIN': IF DA HULL BREAKS WHILE YOU FLY BY HAND, DA [WHOLE PARTY DIES].

[Tab] SKIPS TA DA NEXT STAGE, HOLDIN' [Cancel] SKIPS TA DA ARRIVAL, [M] SHOWS DA CHART!

partyOrigins.title: ORIGINS
partyOrigins.description:
DA LAST STEP OF CREATION PICKS AN [ORIGIN]: WHERE AN' HOW DA PARTY STARTS. EVERY PARTY ALSO GETS A FEW POTIONS, A PACKED MEAL AN' A CHEAP [HYPERDECK | hypernetHyperdeck].

- [TRAVEL STARTS]: BY TRAIN, CAMPER, CAR OR BIKE, OUT IN SPACE, STRANDED SOMEWHERE REMOTE, OR AT DA GATE OF DA [TOWER | worldDungeon].
- [MONEY AND POWER]: A CEO WIT A FORTUNE, A MAYOR WIT A CITY, A DIPLOMAT WIT A SEAT IN DA [ASSEMBLY | peopleONU], AN' MORE.
- [ARMIES | societyArmy]: LEAD TROOPS OF A FACTION, DESERT ONE, RULE AS A WARLORD, MARCH WIT DA GOBLIN HORDE, OR BECOME GOBLINS YOURSELVES.
- [GEAR STARTS]: AN ARCANIST WIT FORBIDDEN LORE, A MERCENARY WIT GUNS, AN AUGMENTED CREW WIT [AUGMENTS | healthAugments], A CARD COLLECTOR WIT A [DECK | gamesCards], AN' MORE.
- [ODD STARTS]: A [WANTED | lawCrime] CRIMINAL, A CRASH LANDIN' ON A STRANGE PLANET, A WAKE UP IN A BUNKER, AN' STRANGER TINKZ.

SOME ORIGINS MAKE DA ROAD AHEAD MUCH HARDER!

pastimesReading.title: BOOKCASES AN' READIN'
pastimesReading.description:
A [BOOKCASE] HOLDS A FEW BOOKS WORTH LEAFIN' THROUGH. READIN' ONE GIVES DA WHOLE PARTY SOME [FUN | needsLeisure] AN', DA FIRST TIME, A LIL' [KP | progressKnowledge].

STUDYIN' STATUES, PAINTINGS, MASKS AN' FOSSILS WORKS DA SAME WAY.

SOME SHELVES HOLD A REAL BOOK YOU CAN [TAKE], AN' ANY SHELF CAN KEEP ONE OF YA OWN UNTIL YOU COME BACK FOR IT. WIT A [RAMAN PROBE | gamesRaman] YOU CAN ALSO [ANALYZE] WHAT SITS DERE.

READABLE BOOKS OPEN IN A BOOK VIEWER. DRAG A PAGE TA TURN IT, OR FLING IT OFF DA SCREEN TA TEAR IT OUT. ENTER LEAVES A BOOKMARK, SHIFT JUMPS TA DA NEXT ONE!

combatBestiary.title: DA BESTIARY
combatBestiary.description:
DA [BESTIARY] LISTS EVERY CREATURE YOU HAB MET. A CREATURE JOINS IT AS SOON AS A FIGHT BEGINS, EVEN IF YOU RUN.

EACH ENTRY HAB THREE TABS:
- [LEXICON]: WHAT IT IZ, HOW STRONG IT IZ, WHAT HURTS IT
- [ECOLOGY]: WHERE AN' WHEN IT LIVES, IN WHICH [BIOMES | worldBiomes]
- [EXTRACTION]: WHAT IT LEAVES BEHIND WHEN [HARVESTED | combatCorpses] AN' HOW IT FIGHTS

A 3D MODEL OF DA CREATURE TURNS BESIDE DA PAGE. BEINGS MET ON [OTHER PLANETS | galaxyLanding] FILL AN ALIEN CHAPTER OF DEY OWN!

travelTickets.title: TICKETS AN' FARE DODGIN'
travelTickets.description:
BUSES, TRAINS, FERRIES, FLIGHTS AN' DA FASTER LINES ALL SELL [TICKETS], AN' DA CLERK WRITES YA NAME DOWN. WIT A [BOUNTY | lawCrime] ON YA HEAD, OR DA POLICE ON YA HEELS, NOBODY WILL SELL YOU ONE. TAXIS AN' YA OWN VEHICLES NEVER ASK.

SHORT OF MONEY, YOU CAN CHOOSE [TRAVEL WITH NO TICKET]. DA TRIP RUNS AS USUAL, BUT AN INSPECTOR MAY WALK DA AISLE. A SHORT HOP IZ USUALLY SAFE, A LONG TRIP RARELY IZ. GETTIN' CAUGHT MEANS A [FARE EVASION] CHARGE.

A VEHICLE WITOUT ENOUGH FUEL DOES NO LEAVE.

ON DA [HYPERNET | hypernetOS], [WAYFARE] LISTS PRICES AN' TRAVEL TIMES FOR EVERY STOP, AN' [HAIL] CALLS A TAXI TA WHEREVER YOU STAND ON OPEN GROUND. YOU CAN ALSO ASK A VEHICLE OWNER FOR A RIDE FROM DA [EMPATHIZE | peopleEmpathize] PANEL!

travelOwnPlaces.title: PLACES OF YA OWN
travelOwnPlaces.description:
A VEHICLE NEEDS NO STATION. FROM DA TRAVEL SCREEN OF DA [CAMPER | vehicleCamper] OR DA [CAR | vehicleCar], CHOOSE [WRITE DOWN A PLACE OF YOUR OWN], PICK A SQUARE OF DA WORLD MAP AN' NAME IT. IT BECOMES A PIN ONLY YA VEHICLES CAN REACH.

MOUNTAINS, OPEN WATER, RIVERS AN' PLACES DAT ALREADY HAB A NAME NO CAN BE CHOSEN.

TOWNS YOU [FOUND | craftingTownFounding] BECOME STOPS FOR EVERYONE IN YA WORLD, AN' AN OPEN [PATRON'S VAULT | galaxyPatrons] ADDS A FREE STATION OF ITS OWN. SOME TOWNS READ [OFFLINE]: STILL ON DA MAP, BUT NO LINE GOES DERE ANY MORE!

lawWitnesses.title: WITNESSES
lawWitnesses.description:
MOST DEEDS REACH YA [RECORD | lawCrime] ONLY IF SOMEBODY SAW DEM AN' CHOSE TA TALK.

A WITNESS HAB TA SEE YOU: CLOSE BY, LOOKIN' YA WAY, WIT NUTTIN' IN BETWEEN. DARKNESS AN' A LEADER WIT A GOOD [STEALTH] LOOK MAKE YOU HARDER TA SPOT.

YA OWN COMPANIONS NEVER TALK, AN' NEITHER DO PEOPLE WHO LIKE DA PARTY ENOUGH. A FRIGHTENIN' [INTIMIDATION] LOOK CAN BUY SILENCE TOO. POLICE OFFICERS ALWAYS REPORT, AN' SO DOES DA [VICTIM].

WHEN TAKIN' TINKZ FROM A HOME, NOISE MATTERS: HEAVIER HAULS IZ LOUDER, AN' EVERY PAIR OF EYES OR EARS NEARBY MAKES IT WORSE. IF NOBODY CAN SEE OR HEAR YOU, YOU SIMPLY GET AWAY WIT IT.

OPEN GROUND, SHOPS, INNS, PUBLIC BUILDINGS AN' YA OWN PLACES IZ NEVER THEFT!

lawArrest.title: BEING ARRESTED
lawArrest.description:
AN OFFICER WHO CATCHES YOU OFFERS A CHOICE: [PAY DA BOUNTY | lawCrime], [GO TA TRIAL | lawTrial], READ DA CHARGES, [RESIST ARREST], [GO TA JAIL | lawPrison] OR [BRIBE THE OFFICER].

A BRIBE COSTS LESS DEN DA BOUNTY, AN' WHETHER IT WORKS IZ A [DICE CHECK | partyDiceChecks] ON DA LEADER'S [PSI | partyAttributes] AGAINST DA OFFICER'S CONSCIENCE.

- TAKEN: DA MONEY IZ GONE, AN' DAT OFFICER LOOKS DA OTHER WAY FOR A WHILE
- REFUSED: YOU KEEP DA MONEY, BUT OFFERIN' IT IZ [BRIBERY], A CRIME OF ITS OWN. YOU CAN TRY AGAIN
- AN [INCORRUPTIBLE] OFFICER CAN NEVER BE BOUGHT, AN' DA OFFER STILL COUNTS AGAINST YOU

lawJurisdictions.title: WHOSE LAW APPLIES
lawJurisdictions.description:
THREE CODES OF LAW RULE DA WORLD, EACH KEEPIN' ITS OWN RECORD. WHICH ONE YOU STAND UNDER DEPENDS ON WHO HOLDS DA COUNTRY.

- [COMMON LAW]: MOST OF DA WORLD
- [CANON LAW]: DA [HOLY VATICAN EMPIRE | vaticanEmpire], WIT ITS OWN CHARGES AN' ITS OWN BLIND SPOTS
- [HORDE LAW]: DA [GOBLIN HORDE | goblinHorde] PUNISHES THEFT AN' LIL' ELSE

A [BOUNTY | lawCrime] NEVER CROSSES A BORDER. DA OTHER RECORD WAITS FOR YOU TA COME BACK.

CANON LAW IZ DA HARSHEST. A [WITCH | partyClasses] OR A [GUNMANCER] IN DA PARTY IZ MARKED ON SIGHT, AN' ONLY A SERVED SENTENCE LIFTS DAT MARK. AN [ATHEIST] IZ FINED, AN' CASTIN' [ESOTERIC] OR [FORBIDDEN] MAGIC INSIDE DA EMPIRE IZ HERESY, WITNESSED OR NO.

IN AN EMPTY WORLD NOBODY IZ LEFT TA KEEP DA LAW!

lawCriminalCareer.title: DA CRIMINAL'S TRADE
lawCriminalCareer.description:
EVERY CRIME TEACHES DA TRADE BEHIND IT: SHOPLIFTIN' TRAINS [PICKPOCKETING], BURGLARY [LOCKPICKING], A BANK JOB [SAFECRACKING], FRAUD [DECEPTION], AN' SO ON. BIGGER JOBS TEACH BIGGER LESSONS.

[STREETWISE] TRAININ' LEAVES LESS FOR DA POLICE TA FIND, SO DA SAME DEED COSTS A SMALLER [BOUNTY | lawCrime].

A [POLICE OFFICER | partyClasses] IN DA PARTY CAN SIGN OFF LIL' CHARGES AS LAWFUL ACTS EVERY DAY, AN' WHAT DEY SIGN NEVER REACHES DA RECORD. [CANON LAW | lawJurisdictions] ACCEPTS NO BADGE.

A TRULY SPECTACULAR DAY OF CRIME MAKES DA FRONT PAGE OF DA [NEWS | societyNews]. BEAT [ERIS | eris] IN HER OWN COURT AN' YA BOUNTY NEVER GROWS AGAIN IN DAT WORLD!

economyWorkplaces.title: BUYIN' A WORKPLACE
economyWorkplaces.description:
BESIDES HOUSES AN' SHOPS YOU CAN BUY A WHOLE [BUSINESS]: AN INDOOR PLACE WHERE PEOPLE WORK. BUY DA ONE YOU STAND IN FROM DA [ASSETS] SCREEN, OR ANY OF DEM FROM DA [WORKING PLACES] TAB OF DA [REAL ESTATE BOARD | econProperty].

DA PRICE DEPENDS ON DA STAFF IT KEEPS, AN' NEVER DROPS BELOW [5000 EUROS]. ABANDONED BUILDINGS AN' PLACES ALREADY OWNED IN YA WORLD NO CAN BE BOUGHT.

DA STAFF KEEP WORKIN' AN' DA BUSINESS PAYS YOU A PROFIT EVERY [WEEK]. IN A THRIVIN' TOWN IT EARNS WELL; IN A TOWN ON ITS KNEES IT CAN LOSE MONEY.

OWNIN' IT LETS YOU [BUILD | craftFurniture] DERE AN' MAKES ITS CONTAINERS YA. ITS PEOPLE AN' ITS COUNTERS IZ NO: [STEALIN' | econStealing] DERE IZ STILL A CRIME. YOU CAN SELL IT BACK FOR A LIL' LESS DEN YOU PAID!

economyLandClaims.title: CLAIMIN' LAND
economyLandClaims.description:
FROM DA [ASSETS] SCREEN YOU CAN [CLAIM] DA GROUND YOU STAND ON, FOR FREE. A CLAIM LETS YOU [BUILD | craftFurniture] DERE AN' GIVES BENCHED COMPANIONS A PLACE TA WAIT.

DA [WORLD MAP | worldMapPage], SETTLEMENTS AN' ROADS CAN NEVER BE CLAIMED.

GROUND DAT ALREADY BELONGS TA SOMEONE CAN STILL BE TAKEN, BUT DAT IZ SQUATTIN': YOU IZ WARNED FIRST, AN' IT COSTS A [TRESPASSIN' | lawCrime] CHARGE OF [25 EUROS].

GIVE A CLAIM UP FROM DA SAME SCREEN, AN' WHOEVER WAITED DERE COMES HOME!

craftingTownFounding.title: FOUNDIN' A TOWN
craftingTownFounding.description:
ANY WORLD MAP SQUARE WIT THREE HOUSES, BUILT OR FOUND, CAN BECOME A TOWN.

1. OPEN DA [TOWN] TAB OF DA [BUILD | craftFurniture] MENU.
2. GIVE DA PLACE A NAME.
3. SIGN DA CHARTER.

YA TOWN BELONGS TA DA WORLD: EVERY PARTY DERE FINDS IT ON DA [WORLD MAP | worldMapPage] AN', ON EARTH, IN DA [TRAVEL BOOK | travelOverview].

NEWCOMERS DRIFT IN OVER DA DAYS AN' PAY YOU RENT. EVERY HOUSE YOU RAISE BRINGS MORE OF DEM. COLLECT WHAT IZ OWED FROM DA [ASSETS] SCREEN!

setupWorldCreation.title: CREATIN' A WORLD
setupWorldCreation.description:
NEW WORLDS IZ MADE FROM DA [WORLDS | worldsFolders] SCREEN OF DA TITLE MENU. DA FORM ASKS FOR:

- A [NAME] AN' A [SEED]
- DA [STARTIN' DATE | setupStartDate]
- DA [STARTIN' LEVEL | setupStartLevel]
- DA [ALTERNATE TIMELINE | setupTimelines]: WHO LIVES DERE
- DA [MAGIC LEVEL | setupMagic]: HOW MUCH MAGIC DERE IZ
- DA [REWARD MULTIPLIERS | setupRewards]
- DA [SKILL LEVEL LIMITS | setupSkillLimits]

EVERYTINK IZ CHOSEN [ONCE]. NO FIDDLY BIT CAN BE CHANGED LATER: TA PLAY DIFFERENTLY, MAKE ANOTHER WORLD. A NOTE UNDER EACH ROW TELLS YOU WHAT A CHOICE MEANS BEFORE YOU CONFIRM!

setupTimelines.title: ALTERNATE TIMELINES
setupTimelines.description:
DA [ALTERNATE TIMELINE] DECIDES WHO LIVES IN DA WORLD. IT IZ PICKED ONCE, AN' PAIRS WIT ANY [MAGIC LEVEL | setupMagic].

[NORMAL]: HISTORY AS IT HAPPENED.

[WORLD OF CHAOS]: EVERYTINK IZ DRAWN AT RANDOM. STRANGE FACES, STRANGE SHOPS, STRANGE FOES, AN' EVERY LEVEL UP TEACHES A [RANDOM SKILL | setupSkillLimits].

[GOBLIN MODE]: EVERYONE IZ A GOBLIN, AN' DA [GOBLIN HORDE | goblinHorde] ALREADY RULES MOST OF EUROPE ON DA FIRST DAY.

[MONSTER WORLD]: NO HUMANS, ELVES OR GOBLINS. TOWNS IZ FULL OF CREATURES, AN' SOME OF DEM KEEP SHOP.

[EMPTY WORLD]: EVERYBODY IZ GONE. SHELVES IZ NEVER RESTOCKED, DOORS HANG OPEN, STREETLIGHTS STAY DARK, AN' ONLY MUTE MONSTERS STILL ROAM.

[ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE | peopleZombies]: DA WALKIN' DEAD FILL DA STREETS, LIVIN' PEOPLE IZ RARE, AN' DERE IZ NO TALKIN' YA WAY OUT. SOME SHAMBLE, SOME RUN.

[DEATH WORLD]: AN EMPTY WORLD WIT NO MONSTERS EITHER. NUTTIN' MOVES ANYWHERE!

setupMagic.title: WORLD MAGIC
setupMagic.description:
DA [MAGIC LEVEL] SETS HOW MUCH MAGIC DA WORLD HOLDS. IT IZ PICKED ONCE, AN' WORKS WIT ANY [ALTERNATE TIMELINE | setupTimelines].

[NORMAL]: EVERYTINK EXISTS.

[SEVERED MAGIC]: MAGIC NEVER WORKED HERE. NO SPELLS, NO MAGICAL CLASSES OR CREATURES, NO ENCHANTED GEAR, NO [MP | combatAP], NO BROOMS.

[UNBOUND MAGIC]: MAGIC WON. GUNS, MACHINES AN' MODERN GADGETS IZ NEVER FOUND, ORDINARY BEASTS GIVE WAY TA MAGICAL ONES, AN' DA ORDINARY CLASSES NO CAN BE PICKED.

PLAIN TINKZ, A ROPE, A SWORD, A LOAF OF BREAD, EXIST EVERYWHERE, AN' [ALCHEMISTRY | craftAlchemy] IZ STUDIED UNDER EVERY LEVEL.

WHAT DA PARTY IZ ALREADY [GIVEN] IZ NEVER TAKEN AWAY. DA LEVEL ONLY DECIDES WHAT DA WORLD OFFERS FROM DEN ON!

setupStartDate.title: STARTIN' DATE
setupStartDate.description:
A WORLD CAN BEGIN ANY MONTH FROM [JANUARY 2001] TA [JANUARY 2013]. DA YEARS BEFORE YA START IZ LIVED OUT FIRST, SO A LATER WORLD ALREADY HAB DAT HISTORY.

A LATER START IZ A HARDER WORLD: MONSTERS GROW FIERCER YEAR AFTER YEAR, THOUGH A FEW COUNTRIES STAY GENTLE. IN RETURN, [LOOT | gearRarity] IZ RICHER. PICK A [STARTIN' LEVEL | setupStartLevel] TA MATCH, AN' REMEMBER DA WORLD KEEPS GETTIN' HARDER OVER TIME.

[STORY MODE] IZ WRITTEN FOR 2001. ANY OTHER YEAR SKIPS DA TUTORIAL.

A WORLD DAT STARTS IN [2013] BEGINS AFTER DA IMPACT OF [21 DECEMBER 2012]: DERE IZ NO EARTH, AN' DA ROAD LEADS TA DA [OMEGA TOWER | omegaTower] INSTEAD. A WORLD DAT REACHES DAT DAY IN PLAY LOSES EARTH DA SAME WAY!

setupStartLevel.title: STARTIN' LEVEL
setupStartLevel.description:
EVERY CHARACTER MADE IN DA WORLD STARTS AT DIS [LEVEL | progressLevels], ANYWHERE FROM [1] TA [99], ALREADY KNOWIN' DA CLASS SKILLS DAT COME WIT IT.

A HIGH STARTIN' LEVEL IZ WHAT MAKES DA LATER [STARTIN' DATES | setupStartDate] SURVIVABLE, AN' [LOOT | gearRarity] RISES TA MATCH IT.

[STORY MODE] ALWAYS STARTS EM AT LEVEL 1!

setupRewards.title: REWARD MULTIPLIERS
setupRewards.description:
THREE SLIDERS ON DA WORLD FORM DECIDE HOW GENEROUSLY A [WON FIGHT | combatCorpses] PAYS: [EXPERIENCE | progressLevels], [MONEY | econMoney] AN' [KP | progressKnowledge].

SLIDE LEFT TOWARD [NOTHING], RIGHT TOWARD A FEAST, OR LEAVE DEM IN DA MIDDLE FOR A NORMAL GAME.

ONLY FIGHTS IZ AFFECTED. [QUESTS | econQuests], [WORK | econWork] AN' SHOPS PAY AS USUAL!

setupSkillLimits.title: SKILL LEVEL LIMITS
setupSkillLimits.description:
TWO SWITCHES ON DA WORLD FORM KEEP DA RAREST SKILLS OUT OF REACH OF BEGINNERS: ONE FOR [ESOTERIC] SKILLS, ONE FOR [FORBIDDEN] ONES.

BOTH IZ ON UNLESS YOU TURN DEM OFF. WIT A LIMIT OFF, ANYONE CAN LEARN DOZE SKILLS FROM DA [SKILL TREE | progressAtlas], FROM [BOOKS | progressGrimoires] OR FROM TEACHERS, AN' IN A [WORLD OF CHAOS | setupTimelines] A LEVEL UP CAN HAND DEM OUT FREELY.

A FORBIDDEN SKILL IZ ESOTERIC TOO, SO DA ESOTERIC SWITCH BLOCKS IT TOO!

setupSandbox.title: SANDBOX MODE
setupSandbox.description:
[SANDBOX] ON DA TITLE MENU STARTS A FREE PLAY PARTY IN DA ACTIVE WORLD, AS A POWERFUL [ERIS | eris] ON DA DISK OF DISCORD.

A SANDBOX PAGE IN DA MAIN MENU DOES WHAT YOU ASK: START ANY BATTLE, GIVE ANY ITEM, TELEPORT ANYWHERE, CHANGE TIME AN' WEATHER, EDIT DA WORLD, AN' OPEN DA [WISHIN' SANCTUM | gearWishOrb].

SKILLS, CRAFTIN' AT DA [WORKBENCH | craftThinker] AN' DA [FORGE | craftForge] AN' BUILDIN' COST NUTTIN', CRIMES ADD NO BOUNTY, AN' DA [BESTIARY | combatBestiary] IZ ALREADY FULL.

DA SANDBOX HAB ITS OWN STASH AN' IZ NEVER AUTOSAVED!

needsRestWorth.title: WHAT A REST GIVES BACK
needsRestWorth.description:
A FULL NIGHT'S REST BRINGS HP, MP AN' AP ALL DA WAY BACK, WEARS OFF EVERY STATE AN' SETS BROKEN PARTS. A SHORTER REST GIVES ITS SHARE, AN' SHORT RESTS [ADD UP] OVER TIME.

- [SLEEPING ROUGH], WIT NO BED, CAMP OR BEDDIN', IZ A POOR REST DAT HEALS NO WOUNDS. A [BEDROLL] IN DA PACK OR A BED NEARBY FIXES DAT
- [WAITING] HEALS NO HP, BUT SLOWLY RESTORES AP AN' MP
- UNDER [BLOOD AN' OIL | combatModes] A BED RESTORES ONLY MP AN' AP, AN' WOUNDS DO NO HEAL

A LONG SLEEP MAY LEAD TA A [DREAM | worldDreams]. YOU CAN ENTER IT OR SIMPLY WAKE UP.

DA REST MENU CAN ALSO [STASH | savingGame] DA GAME AN' [SET YA RESPAWN POINT | partyDeath], EXCEPT UNDER PERMADEATH OR BLOOD AN' OIL.

SLEEP IN BATTLE COUNTS TOO: DOZIN' UNDER DA [SLEEP | sleep] STATE RESTS YOU, AN' BEING [WET | wet] WASHES YOU A LIL'!

needsForage.title: FORAGIN' FOR HOURS
needsForage.description:
[FORAGE] IN DA REST MENU SPENDS DA HOURS WORKIN' INSTEAD OF WAITIN'. DA PARTY SCATTERS OVER DA GROUND AN' COMES BACK WIT WHATEVER DA LAND GIVES: WILD FOOD AN' CRAFTIN' MATERIALS.

MORE HANDS AN' TRAININ' IN [FORAGIN' | progressSpecializations] BRING BACK MORE, AN' EVERY HOUR TEACHES A LIL' [KP | progressKnowledge]. DA WORK IZ TIRIN': SLEEP AN' HUNGER DRAIN FASTER DEN WHEN WAITIN'.

A PARTY DAT GETS ON WELL ENJOYS DA [COMPANY | needsSocial]; ONE DAT DOES NO DRIFTS APART A LIL'.

FORAGIN' IN A VEHICLE ONLY TURNS UP LITTER FROM UNDER DA SEATS!

needsCamp.title: MAKIN' CAMP
needsCamp.description:
[MAKE A CAMP] FROM DA [WORLD MAP | worldMapPage] OR DA VEHICLE MENU, AN' DA [REST MENU | needsRestWorth] OPENS AS A CAMP.

A NIGHT AT CAMP GIVES DA USUAL REST AN' MORE: EVERYONE FRESHENS UP A LIL' ON [HYGIENE | needsHygiene] AN' [COMPANY | needsSocial] AROUND DA FIRE.

IF DA PARTY IZ HUNGRY, SOMEBODY [COOKS | craftCooking] FROM WHAT IZ IN DA PACK, SMALLEST MEALS FIRST. WIT NUTTIN' TA COOK, DA CAMP TELLS YOU.

WAITIN' AT CAMP IZ JUST AS GOOD AS SLEEPIN' DERE. DA CAMP IZ STRUCK ONCE YOU REST OR LEAVE DA MENU!

needsBladder.title: BLADDER
needsBladder.description:
DA [BLADDER] METER RUNS DOWN WIT TIME, FASTER WIT EVERY DRINK, ESPECIALLY ALCOHOL AN' COFFEE. ASLEEP IT RUNS SLOWER, AN' A NIGHT'S REST NEVER ENDS IN AN ACCIDENT.

WHEN IT RUNS LOW ITS CHIP WARNS YOU. A [WC], A SHOWER, A BATH OR A [SWIM | worldMovement] SETS TINKZ RIGHT FOR DA WHOLE PARTY.

WAIT TOO LONG AN' DA MEMBER WETS THEMSELVES ON DA SPOT, LOSIN' A GOOD DEAL OF HYGIENE AN' COMPANY. CREATURES WITOUT A HUMAN MIND DO NO CARE.

ON DA [WORLD MAP | worldMapPage] OR DA OPEN ROAD DA PARTY STOPS BY DA ROADSIDE IN TIME!

peopleHolidays.title: HOLIDAYS AN' GATHERINGS
peopleHolidays.description:
EVERY COUNTRY KEEPS ITS OWN [PUBLIC HOLIDAYS], FROM CHRISTMAS AN' EASTER TA EID, DIWALI AN' NATIONAL DAYS. LANDS RULED BY A [HYPERPOWER | peoplePolitics] KEEP ITS FEASTS TOO.

ON A HOLIDAY OFFICES AN' WORKSHOPS CLOSE, WHILE SHOPS AN' DA TRADES OF A DAY OFF STAY OPEN.

EVERY HOLIDAY BRINGS A [GATHERING] TA TOWN: A FESTIVAL, A PARADE, A VIGIL OR A PROTEST. RALLIES COME BEFORE AN [ELECTION | powersElections] AN' QUEUES FILL DA POLLS ON DA DAY. DA TOWN POURS INTO ONE SQUARE, AN' A NOTICE TELLS YOU WHEN IT IZ UNDER WAY.

DA [CALENDAR | hypernetCalendar] ON DA [HYPERDECK DESKTOP | hypernetOS] LISTS HOLIDAYS, ELECTIONS, YA [QUEST | econQuests] DEADLINES AN' YA OWN APPOINTMENTS, WIT REMINDERS!

gearWishOrb.title: DA WISH-GRANTIN' ORB
gearWishOrb.description:
A [WISH-GRANTING ORB] CAN BE BOUGHT FOR [10,000 EUROS] OR [CRAFTED | craftThinker]. USED FROM DA MENU, IT RESTORES DA PARTY FULLY AN' OPENS DA [WISHING SANCTUM].

DA SANCTUM OFFERS A SPREAD OF RANDOM WISHES: AN ITEM, A FIGHT, A SUDDEN FORTUNE, A [STOCK MARKET | econStocks] BOOM, A BODY MADE WHOLE AGAIN, AN' STRANGER TINKZ. PICK ONE AN' IT COMES TRUE.

EACH ORB GRANTS ONE WISH. LEAVIN' DA SANCTUM WITOUT CHOOSIN' WASTES DA ORB.

A PARTY WIT WEAK [PSI | partyAttributes] SEES DA WISHES AS RIDDLES, OR WORSE!

partyDiceChecks.title: DICE CHECKS
partyDiceChecks.description:
MANY ACTIONS IZ SETTLED BY A [D20] THROWN ON SCREEN: [STEALIN' | econStealing], [TRIALS | lawTrial], [SURGERY | healthSurgery], [COOKIN' | craftCooking], [FUSIN' SPELLS | progressFusion], WORK SHIFTS AN' CHANCES DA WORLD OFFERS YOU.

A STRONG [ATTRIBUTE | partyAttributes] ADDS TA DA ROLL, A WEAK ONE TAKES AWAY. DA TOTAL MUST REACH DA NUMBER SHOWN.

- A [NATURAL 20] ALWAYS SUCCEEDS
- A [NATURAL 1] ALWAYS FAILS

WHEN DA WORLD OFFERS A CHECK, A CARD SHOWS WHAT IZ BEING TESTED AN' WHAT YOU NEED. YOU CAN [WALK AWAY] AN' NUTTIN' HAPPENS. DA PARTY LEADER ROLLS UNLESS DA CHECK NAMES SOMEONE ELSE!

powersTravelJournal.title: DA TRAVEL JOURNAL
powersTravelJournal.description:
USING A [POCKET NOTEBOOK], A [TRAVEL JOURNAL], A PEN OR A QUILL FROM DA [BACKPACK | gearBackpack] OPENS YA [TRAVEL JOURNAL]: A NOTEBOOK YOU WRITE YOURSELF.

PICK A PAGE ON DA RIGHT AN' TYPE ON DA LEFT. EACH PAGE TAKES ITS NAME FROM ITS FIRST LINE, AN' PAGES CAN BE ADDED OR DELETED.

DA JOURNAL TRAVELS WIT YA [STASH | savingGame], AN' ON DA DESKTOP BUILD ITS PAGES CAN BE READ OUTSIDE DA GAME TOO. WRITIN' USES NUTTIN' UP!
